title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
title_zh: AutoScaffold：语言模型强化学习的AI引导脚手架
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all four domains, with gains of 7.2 points in ALFWorld success and 4.0 points in average QA exact match. On GPU kernel generation, AutoScaffold increases the fraction of tasks with a correct kernel that runs faster than the PyTorch reference by up to 5.0 points. On math, our student surpasses QuestA's reported accuracy using approximately one-third as many student training steps. Analyses show that the teacher identifies a different failure in each task class and shifts its scaffolds from step-by-step workflows to targeted fixes as the student improves, and that its revised scaffolds help the student learn more than keeping the previous scaffold or using no scaffold.
summary_zh: RLVR中结果奖励丢失大量训练信息，且现有训练脚手架依赖人工设计，缺乏自适应性。
提出AutoScaffold框架，由冻结的教师模型定期诊断学生瓶颈，自动生成共享策略与任务提示作为脚手架。
在四个领域无脚手架评估下均超越RL基线，数学推理以1/3训练步数超QuestA，且脚手架能随学习进展动态调整。

title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
title_zh: 对比发现：基于竞争解释的开放式科学发现
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.
summary_zh: 现有LLM agent逐点评估假设，仅检验假设的否命题，导致证据拒绝假设时无法确定支持哪个替代解释。
提出对比发现方法，用互斥且穷尽的对比集替代单一假设，根据证据在对比集上的信念重分布评分，直至信念集中于某一解释。
实验表明，对比集能在相同证据下将73%的拒绝结果转化为具体替代解释，引导搜索时多解决67%的问题，且与人类专家高度一致。
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 55 pages. Project page: https://codiscovery.ai/contrastive-discovery/

title: Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
title_zh: Pyrite：蛋白质-配体姿态排序智能体的构建与基准测试
abstract: Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains challenging. We introduce Pyrite, a pairwise pose-ranking benchmark comprising 1,500 pose pairs across diverse protein-ligand complexes. Expert chemists equipped with 3D visualization tools and physics-based scores perform near chance, highlighting the difficulty of interpreting available chemical signals. To investigate automated ranking, we introduce PyriteRep, a structured representation of molecular geometry, protein-ligand interactions, and physicochemical scores, and develop two LLM-based agents: PyriteReasoner, which directly compares poses through text-based reasoning, and PyriteFeaturizer, which generates executable code to construct features for logistic regression, optionally incorporating features derived from LLM subcalls. These agents achieve up to 67% and 74% accuracy, respectively, exceeding observed expert performance. LLM-guided feature discovery generally outperforms direct reasoning, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves open-weight models, enabling them to match or surpass closed-source frontier models in our evaluations. These results establish Pyrite as a challenging test of pose-ranking ability and highlight LLM-guided feature discovery as a promising approach to interpret and combine the outputs of computational chemistry tools.
summary_zh: 配体结合姿态排序对药物发现至关重要，但现有模型生成的候选姿态可靠排序仍具挑战性。
构建包含1500对姿态的基准Pyrite，发现专家借助3D工具和物理评分仅达随机水平，凸显排序难度。
提出基于LLM的排序智能体，其中特征生成智能体准确率达74%，超越专家，表明LLM引导的特征发现是有效方法。
comment: 32 pages, Agentic AI for Biological Discovery Workshop (NeurIPS 2026)

title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
title_zh: Continual-ARC：衡量工作生涯中的技能获取
abstract: Agent harnesses have emerged as a promising mechanism for continual learning, alongside test-time parametric learning. However, the current benchmarks have several limitations: they generally focus on a single applied domain, serve each instance only once, and assume a single family of learner, so memory-based and weight-based systems are rarely compared on the same scale. We propose Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream built from the three ARC-AGI editions, whose tasks need no domain knowledge. The same tasks return after dormant gaps with fresh instances, while new tasks keep arriving. On each instance, the learner may pay for demonstrations, submit answers, or act inside the harness, with retries permitted on incorrect submissions, which are paid for. Each instance is scored based on the share of this feedback budget consumed. Since a learner may keep anything between instances, memory-based and weight-based systems are scored on the same scale. After the stream, the learner is frozen and tested on fresh instances of the tasks it met, which measures memorization, and on unseen tasks, which measures generalization. We run an agent harness with frozen weights, with and without persistence, on Qwen3.5-9B and GLM-5.3 Flash, comparing them with two prompting floors, a program-induction method and Qwen3.5-9B's weights trained to imitate GLM-5.3 Flash. Persistence in the harness generally does not improve memorization unless provided with explicit expert guidance. Most harness-based methods still learn less than a floor that simply caches each task's demonstrations, across all models we tested. No harness-based method gains on unseen tasks, whereas weight-based learning shows substantial gains. This opens the door to future weight-based continual learning that could teach models to drive harnesses in new domains.
summary_zh: 现有持续学习基准多局限于单领域、单次测试且缺乏对记忆与权重系统的统一评估，无法有效衡量终身学习。
提出Continual-ARC基准，任务无需领域知识且会重复出现，允许系统通过交互获取反馈，统一评估记忆与权重系统。
实验表明，基于harness的方法泛化能力无提升且记忆效果不如简单缓存，而基于权重的学习泛化增益显著。
comment: 51 pages, 13 figures. Code and run records: https://github.com/unifyai/continual-arc

title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
title_zh: ReTrace：将工具调用Agent蒸馏为无规划器工作流
abstract: Business process automation runs the same Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) again and again on new inputs. Large Language Model (LLM) agents can follow an SOP written in natural language, but they call an LLM to choose every step of every run, which adds latency and cost at scale. We present ReTrace, which turns an SOP and a few logged agent runs into a reusable workflow in which code, not an LLM, selects the next step. The agent's reasoning, the explanation it writes with each tool call, often states why it took an action; the tool calls alone do not. ReTrace extracts the condition behind each step, merges these conditions across runs into a compact rule document, and generates an executable workflow from it. Only this last stage depends on the platform, so rule documents can be compiled for different orchestration platforms. On $79$ procedures from our production platform, ReTrace workflows reach $93.8\%$ completion, against $96.8\%$ for the agent, at $24\%$ lower cost per task. On $τ^2$-Bench, they reach $75.8\%$ task success (agent: $80.6\%$) and run in $1.3$s instead of $170$s; three rounds of repair on training failures lift $k{=}2$ workflows from $66.7\%$ to $81.2\%$. On eight SOP-Bench procedures, ReTrace without repair trails few-shot generation ($80.6\%$ vs. $83.6\%$), but repair from labeled training failures lifts it to $87.8\%$ at $0.40$s per task, compared to $85.5\%$ in $46.6$s for the agent.
summary_zh: LLM agent执行SOP时每次均需调用LLM选步，导致大规模下延迟高且成本大。
ReTrace提取agent推理中的条件，跨运行合并为规则文档，生成由代码选步的可执行工作流。
实验表明该方法大幅降低延迟与成本，经修复后成功率接近agent，实现高效自动化。

title: TanCRAFT: Context-Reasoned Anticipatory Feedback for Assembly Tasks
title_zh: TanCRAFT：面向装配任务的上下文推理预期反馈系统
abstract: Preventing human error in physical assembly tasks requires assistance systems that can intervene before mistakes are made. This is especially challenging in settings where users are free to choose the construction order and correctness depends on the evolving assembly rather than a fixed next step. We present TanCRAFT, a four-stage real-time predictive assistance system that tracks the scene state, reasons about the current partial assembly, forecasts the near-future motion of manipulated pieces, and intervenes when the predicted placement is incompatible with the target. We instantiate our framework and confirm its effectiveness in a controlled tangram assembly task through offline benchmarks and a within-subject user study. Our findings show that the predictive feedback significantly reduces mistakes relative to unguided and reactive sessions, while yielding the lowest mean perceived workload and shortest mean completion time. Overall, these results demonstrate the value of predictive feedback for error prevention and provide a step toward cost-aware assistance for automation and human-robot workcells.
summary_zh: 自由装配顺序下防错难，需在出错前干预而非被动响应。
提出TanCRAFT四阶段实时预测系统，通过跟踪状态、推理当前装配并预测近未来运动，在放置不兼容时干预。
实验表明该预测反馈显著减少错误，且工作负载最低、完成时间最短，验证了预期反馈的防错价值。
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: A Theory of Cross-Validation Variance
title_zh: 交叉验证方差的理论
abstract: Cross-validation estimates predictive performance by repeatedly splitting the data into training and validation sets, fitting the model on the first and evaluating it on the second. Every observation influences the estimate in two roles, through its own evaluation when it is held out and through the models it helps fit when it trains. The random splits determine its weight in each role. From this representation, we prove an exact finite-sample identity for the variance of the cross-validated estimate. For a given splitting scheme with a common training set size, the variance is a function of these weights, with constants of the model, the metric, and the population. It covers metrics averaged over observations, such as mean squared error, and over case--control pairs, such as the AUC. The identity shows which schemes to use. The variance decomposes into sampling variance, which depends only on the training size, and variance due to the random fold splitting, which arises when the weights change from one draw of the splits to the next. K-fold cross-validation, whose weights are equal across observations by design, is therefore variance optimal at first order; Monte Carlo and bootstrap cross-validation are not. The first-order variance of K-fold does not depend on K, and under reasonable conditions on the model leave-one-out has the smallest variance of any K-fold scheme. For the AUC the same holds for leave-pair-out, which evaluates every case--control pair. Finally, we show the cross-validated estimate is asymptotically normal with the identity's full variance. Together, these results provide a general theoretical foundation for inference on cross-validated performance and establish principles for selecting variance-optimal cross-validation designs.
summary_zh: 交叉验证估计的方差难以精确刻画，本文通过分析样本在训练与验证中的双重权重，推导出其精确的有限样本方差恒等式。
该方差可分解为仅依赖训练集大小的抽样方差与随机划分引起的划分方差，此恒等式适用于MSE和AUC等常见指标。
K折交叉验证因权重相等在第一阶方差上最优，且与K值无关；留一法方差最小。该结果为交叉验证推断提供了理论基础与设计原则。
comment: 27 pages main text, 57 pages supplementary material with 6 sections, 1 figure

title: Angle-Resolved Reflectance Measurements in the Vacuum Ultraviolet for Metallic Samples
title_zh: 金属样品在真空紫外波段的角分辨反射率测量
abstract: The light yield of noble-element scintillation detectors depends strongly on the reflective properties of detector materials in the vacuum ultraviolet (VUV), where optical measurements are scarce. For this reason, we built a custom rotary setup at IFIC, equipped with a monochromator and operated in a gaseous argon atmosphere, to perform angle-resolved reflectance measurements in the specular reflection plane. We describe the setup and its extensive characterization, together with the procedure used to measure the bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) of materials at various angles of incidence, for wavelengths from 128 to 500 nm, covering both the argon (128 nm) and xenon (175 nm) scintillation wavelengths. To illustrate the capabilities of the setup, we present results for rough aluminum and stainless-steel surfaces as reference materials. Fitting the measured angular profiles with the analytical GGX microfacet model allows us to extract the real and imaginary parts of the refractive index and the surface roughness parameter of each sample. These parameters are then used to extrapolate the in-plane measurements to the full hemisphere and from gaseous argon to liquid media, enabling the inference of the hemispherical reflectance in gaseous argon, liquid argon and liquid xenon.
summary_zh: 稀有元素闪烁探测器光产额依赖材料在VUV的反射特性，但该波段光学测量数据匮乏。
构建氩气环境下的旋转测量装置，获取128-500nm多入射角的材料双向反射分布函数（BRDF）。
用GGX微面元模型拟合提取折射率与粗糙度，进而推算出材料在气氩、液氩和液氙中的半球反射率。

title: One Policy for 100 Household Tasks: Our Solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
title_zh: 单一策略应对百项家务：2026 BEHAVIOR挑战赛解决方案
abstract: We describe our solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge: 100 long-horizon household tasks in the OmniGibson simulator. We placed 9th on the final leaderboard, the only independent team in the top 10. The core of the solution is a single vision-language-action (VLA) model, one checkpoint for all 100 tasks, built on our 1st-place 2025 solution, which is based on $π_{0.5}$. On the 50 tasks shared with 2025, its Q rises from 0.260 to 0.371; across all 100 tasks it scores 0.392. Our main conclusion from 2025 was that the model was undertrained, so most of the 2026 work went into training the model for longer, optimizing some training parameters, making each training step slightly faster and reducing the gradient noise: a migration from 50 to 100 tasks (semantic stages built from the demonstrations' skill annotations, task and stage embeddings of new tasks warm-started from similar old ones, and a 21-dimensional action space matching the teleoperation controls); variance-reduced multi-sample flow matching with a simple noise-vs-compute model that picks the number of action-expert samples per observation without ablations; and a 200k-step training run, about one pass over the 211M frames of the demonstrations. A cloud evaluation infrastructure keeps a shared record with provenance, episode diagnostics and restorable simulator states, and runs six simulators on one GPU together faster than real time. On top of the learned policy, 14 tasks are routed to a GPT-6 Astra coding agent that controls the robot through observation and motion tools, starting every episode from a frozen copy of its own practice session on training instances. Across these 14 tasks, Astra's mean Q is 0.639, against 0.108 for the learned policy. The public submission included only part of the Astra results and scored 0.446 Q with 27.3% full-task success.
summary_zh: 针对100项长周期家务任务，提出单一VLA模型方案，仅用一个checkpoint即实现所有任务控制，最终排名第九。
针对模型训练不足问题，通过扩展至100任务的语义阶段迁移、方差缩减的多样本流匹配及充分训练，使共享任务Q值提升至0.371。
引入GPT-6 Astra编码agent处理14项任务，其基于练习会话控制机器人，平均Q值达0.639，远超学习策略的0.108。

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
title_zh: 评估LLM生成的世界模型在神经符号推理中的表现
abstract: Formal world models can support planning, verification, and safety reasoning, but constructing them from open-ended natural-language situations is difficult, particularly in multi-agent settings where several formalizations may be plausible. We study whether five LLMs can generate such world models as partially observable stochastic games and whether mechanical validity is sufficient to establish that the resulting model faithfully represents the intended decision problem. We introduce a benchmark of 44 scenarios spanning game, situational, and cultural settings and evaluate generated world models along three dimensions: mechanical validity, reference-relative structural agreement, and semantic criteria. Across three empirical tracks, we analyze 410 first-pass generations. In the reference-backed game track, 134/135 generated world models pass a strict mechanical audit, yet mean permutation-invariant structural F1 is only 0.366, with just 28/134 mechanically valid models exactly matching the authored reference. In the cultural track, explicitly naming the country changes the generated structural representation for most LLMs while producing only small changes in automated semantic scores. These results show that executability is a necessary but insufficient criterion for LLM-generated world models: models that are mechanically valid can still differ substantially in the structure used by downstream neuro-symbolic reasoning and planning.
summary_zh: 从自然语言构建形式化世界模型困难，研究5个LLM能否生成部分可观测随机博弈模型并评估其有效性。
构建含44个场景的基准，从机械有效性、结构一致性和语义标准三个维度评估410个生成模型。
实验表明机械有效是必要但不充分条件，有效模型在结构上仍可能与下游推理所需结构差异巨大。

title: Cognitive Mapping of Learning by Thinking Mechanisms in Large Language Models
title_zh: 大语言模型中“思考学习”机制的认知映射
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit capabilities that resemble human Learning by Thinking (LbT), the acquisition of new insight through internal processes such as explanation and reasoning, without new external input. A systematic account of the cognitive mechanisms behind these capabilities, and of their limits, remains underdeveloped. This paper proposes a Cognitive LbT Framework that maps four mechanisms (Reflective Reasoning, Synthetic Memory Formation, Internal Simulation, and Conceptual Self-Organization) onto computational processes in LLMs. Drawing on representative methods, including chain-of-thought prompting, self-consistency, self-reflection, Tree-of-Thoughts search, Self-Instruct, and self-taught reasoning, the analysis argues that selected methods can functionally approximate aspects of these mechanisms and can improve performance on some tasks without additional labeled examples, although this does not always constitute durable learning in model parameters. For example, Self-Instruct generated approximately 52,000 instructions from 175 seed tasks and reported a 33% absolute improvement on Super-NaturalInstructions (Y. Wang et al., 2023). The same mechanisms also produce characteristic failures, including hallucination diffusion, model collapse, concept drift, and high computational cost. These failures are not isolated technical defects but follow from four structural asymmetries between LLMs and human cognition: the identity of generator and monitor, closed learning loops without external grounding, symbolic rather than sensorimotor simulation, and the cost of inference-time computation. The framework yields testable propositions about when LbT in LLMs should succeed or fail and offers a structured basis for designing more reliable autonomous learning systems.
summary_zh: LLM展现出类似人类无需外部输入的“思考学习”能力，但其认知机制与局限缺乏系统梳理。
提出认知LbT框架，将反思推理等四种机制映射到LLM计算过程，指出部分方法可提升性能但非持久学习。
揭示幻觉扩散等失败源于生成与监督等四种结构不对称性，为设计可靠系统提供结构化基础。
comment: Theoretical framework paper; 24 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure

title: Independent Families Under Determinacy-Like Hypotheses
title_zh: 类决定性假设下的独立族
abstract: We generalize the notion of an independent family on $ω$ to $\mathcal{J}$-independent families on an arbitrary cardinal $κ$ and then show that under determinacy-like hypotheses that there can be no such families for reasonable $\mathcal{J}$. This is quite atypical as all other generalizations of the kinds of combinatorial families coming from the theory of cardinal characteristics follow a very different pattern, which will also be explained; in this sense independent families seem particularly special. The base theory assumed throughout is $\textsf{ZF + }$All infinite sets are Dedekind infinite.
summary_zh: 【问题】如何将ω上的独立族概念推广到任意基数κ上？【方法】引入并研究任意基数κ上的J-独立族。【结论】给出了独立族的一般化推广定义。
【问题】在类决定性假设下，J-独立族是否存在？【方法】在ZF+所有无穷集是Dedekind无穷的基础理论下推导。【结论】证明对合理的J，该假设下不存在此类独立族。
【问题】独立族的推广与其他组合族的推广模式有何差异？【方法】对比基数特征理论中其他组合族的推广模式。【结论】独立族的推广模式极不相同，显得尤为特殊。
comment: 15 Pages, 0 Figures, Submitted to the Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society

title: EngineAgent: Agentizing On-Device LLM Inference Engines with Inference Stack Hierarchy Awareness and Hardware Abilities
title_zh: EngineAgent：具备推理栈层级感知与硬件能力的设备端LLM推理引擎代理
abstract: Rapidly evolving LLM architectures and heterogeneous mobile hardware make supporting new models in on-device inference engines a recurring and costly system challenge. Each model may require coordinated changes across conversion, graph construction, operators, and hardware backends. Existing coding agents often miss these cross-layer dependencies and struggle to diagnose failures across host--device execution paths. We present EngineAgent, an agentic system for automating on-device LLM model enablement. Its key insight is to separate reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation. Before enablement, EngineAgent constructs a hierarchy-aware engine index that captures engine abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, and pre-validates backend-specific build, execution, and debugging workflows using already supported models. For each new model, a builder uses this knowledge to coordinate cross-layer changes, while an auditor checks implementation completeness and drives iterative debugging through device-side validation. Across 12 tasks spanning three mobile LLMs and four engine--backend pairs on CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, EngineAgent achieves 75% end-to-end success with either of two underlying LLMs, versus 33.3% for the strongest coding-agent baseline. Success requires compilation, on-device execution, and output-logit agreement with reference implementations. EngineAgent also reduces average per-task time and model-API cost relative to baselines using the same underlying LLMs.
summary_zh: 设备端LLM推理引擎支持新模型需跨层协同修改，现有coding agent难以处理跨层依赖与诊断故障。
提出EngineAgent，分离可复用引擎知识与模型特定实现，构建层级感知索引并预验证后端工作流。
构建器协调跨层修改，审计器检查完整性并驱动调试。实验中端到端成功率达75%，远超基线且降低耗时与成本。

title: When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
title_zh: LLM智能体何时该记忆？基于证伪门控的自我演化
abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, verifier-rich environments, but current self-improvement mechanisms often write episode-derived lessons directly into memory, making local success an unreliable signal for reusable and safe knowledge. This paper addresses the core question of when an experience-derived behavioral update should be admitted into persistent agent state. We propose Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution (FGSE), a verifier-grounded framework that represents each candidate lesson as a structured hypothesis with an explicit precondition, behavior change, expected effect, and verifier. FGSE applies the hypothesis only in a temporary state, tests it on target-transfer, falsification, and archived-regression probes, and then commits, refines, or rejects it according to measured gain and risk. Across web, app, tool-use, and long-term memory benchmarks, FGSE achieves strong task performance, including 39.8 WebArena success rate, 78.8 AppWorld average completion, and 0.724/0.487 Pass$^1$ on $τ$-Retail/$τ$-Airline, while reducing falsification failures to 5.0%, regression damage to 1.3%, and harmful committed updates to 3.6%. These results suggest that testing memory updates as hypotheses supports more reliable long-term adaptation.
summary_zh: 现有LLM智能体直接将局部成功经验写入记忆，易产生不可复用且不安全的错误知识。
提出证伪门控自我演化框架（FGSE），将候选经验构建为结构化假设，在临时状态中测试。
实验表明FGSE在多基准测试中性能优异，且大幅降低了证伪失败、回归损伤和有害更新比例。
验证了将记忆更新作为假设进行测试，能支持更可靠的智能体长期适应。

title: Auditing the Judge: Internal Signals for LLM Reasoning Assurance
title_zh: 审计判断者：LLM推理保证的内部信号
abstract: Language-model systems use self-judgment to decide which answers to release, review, or recompute. Because intervention is costly, an assurance score must rank errors well at the available budget, not merely over the full ranking. We compare the judge's continuous verdict-token score with a supervised correctness probe trained on attention-head activations from the same prompt. Exact identities link fixed-budget error recall to residual risk and show that AUROC averages recall over all budgets. Across three open 7-12B models on GSM8K and MATH, the probe finds 1.3-22.5 additional percentage points of errors at 5% review in all six model-dataset settings (median 7.4 points). At 10% routing, probe-guided allocation improves accuracy over equal-cost random allocation in both GSM8K experiments, but beats judge-guided routing only for the weaker judge. Cross-dataset transfer lowers probe AUROC for every model in both directions relative to target-domain training. Because dataset, weight precision, and generation budget change together, this measures a joint protocol shift rather than a dataset-only effect. Internal signals can improve supervised, in-domain budget allocation, but are not domain-general confidence estimators.
summary_zh: LLM系统常依赖自判断筛选答案，但干预成本高，需在有限预算内有效排序错误以降低残余风险。
对比LLM的判决词元分数与基于注意力头激活训练的正确性探针，探针在5%审查下多找出1.3-22.5个百分点的错误。
内部信号可改善同领域内的有监督预算分配，但跨域迁移性能下降，并非领域通用的置信度估计器。
comment: The 8th IEEE International Conference on Trust, Privacy and Security in Intelligent Systems, and Applications

title: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
title_zh: 证据关联记忆减少LLM智能体的记忆诱导退化
abstract: External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks. However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation, where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one. This is because lessons are inferred from trajectories labeled only with task success or failure, yet are typically provided without the trajectories they came from, leaving the agent no way to check them. To address this, we introduce WikiTrace, an evidence-linked memory system designed to let agents check each lesson against its original trajectory. Specifically, motivated by the finding that a trajectory often still holds the evidence needed to catch an erroneous lesson, WikiTrace stores each lesson as a concise insight linked to a summary of why its trajectory succeeded or failed and to the raw trajectory itself. Then, on a new task, the agent starts from all insights and, whenever one lacks details needed to act, conflicts with another, or comes from a failed task, descends through its links with terminal tools to fill in missing details or correct the insight before acting. We validate WikiTrace on five agentic benchmarks, showing that it consistently outperforms existing memory approaches and a baseline given the same insights alone, while also reducing memory-induced degradation. Our code is available at https://github.com/yukyeongleee/wikitrace
summary_zh: LLM智能体的记忆可能包含错误或被误用的经验，导致原本能解决的任务失败，即记忆诱导退化。
提出WikiTrace系统，将记忆经验与原始轨迹链接，使智能体能在行动前核实并修正有误的经验。
实验表明，WikiTrace持续优于现有记忆方法，有效减少了记忆诱导退化现象。
comment: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (October 2026 cycle); under review

title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
title_zh: MMDM：大规模多任务决策制定评测基准
abstract: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks, where prior exposure to test material can obscure generalization. Moreover, real-world decision making often involves long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies, challenges that existing benchmarks do not adequately capture together. Thus, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, combining newly constructed tasks with source-grounded recompositions and rewrites for single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh contexts. It covers realistic scenarios such as agent state tracking, tool and skill selection, preference judgments, and rubric scoring, with option spaces ranging from 2 to 1,024 and inputs extending to 64,817 tokens. With MMDM, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of 28 decision models, showing that many perform well on common knowledge yet struggle with interdependent options, constrained decisions, and multi-select tasks. For example, Perplexity Decider-V1.2 reaches 78.75% Hard Single-select Accuracy on world knowledge, but only 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning, while the best Hard Multi-select Accuracy across all models is 36.81%. These results highlight joint reasoning, constraint-aware selection, and complete multi-select recovery as key priorities for decision model development, with MMDM providing a testbed for measuring this progress.
summary_zh: 现有决策模型评测易受数据泄露影响，且未能同时覆盖长上下文、大选项空间与复杂逻辑依赖等真实挑战。
提出 MMDM 基准，包含 5448 道高质量题目与 16 类任务，涵盖单选、多选及软标签决策等真实场景。
对 28 个模型评测发现，其在常识任务表现好，但在选项逻辑与多选任务上表现差，指明联合推理与约束感知是未来重点。

title: Chain of Physics: Supporting Fault Diagnosis with Engineering-Inspired Large Language Model Reasoning
title_zh: 基于物理链与受控知识图谱的LLM故障诊断框架
abstract: Fault diagnosis in complex systems requires linking observed changes in physical quantities to the failure mechanisms that produce them. Experienced engineers perform this task by combining sensor information with knowledge of system behavior and fault propagation. Large Language Models (LLMs) can support this process, but their diagnostic reasoning depends on the availability of asset-specific engineering knowledge and on how this knowledge is represented and used during inference. This work introduces Chain of Physics (CoP), an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework built around a Constrained Knowledge Graph (CKG) generated automatically from asset-specific reference documentation. CoP addresses failure-sensor association from textual engineering knowledge. The CKG stores diagnostic chains connecting failure modes, changes in physical quantities, and monitoring sensors. During inference, semantically similar graph paths are retrieved for each question and used as both information and in-context examples for the reasoning process. Candidate failure modes are extracted from the question and analysed independently through dedicated LLM calls, which generate plausible failure-to-observation chains. A final decision module compares these chains with the available answer choices. CoP is evaluated on the FailureSensorIQ benchmark across four industrial asset classes and three LLMs. Compared with direct prompting and conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), CoP improves diagnostic accuracy across all evaluated models, with gains ranging from 7.8 to 19.6 percentage points and from 11.7 to 18.2 percentage points, respectively. The results show that structured engineering knowledge can improve LLM-based diagnostic reasoning when graph retrieval is combined with in-context examples of fault propagation.
summary_zh: 复杂系统故障诊断需关联物理量变化与失效机制，但LLM推理依赖特定工程知识的表示与调用。
提出CoP框架，从文档自动构建受控知识图谱存储诊断链，推理时检索相似路径作为示例，独立分析候选失效模式。
在FailureSensorIQ基准测试中，CoP比直接提示和RAG分别提升7.8-19.6和11.7-18.2个百分点，验证了结构化知识增强LLM诊断的有效性。

title: Lilo: A Multi-Agent Conversational Sandbox for Children's Digital Communication
title_zh: Lilo：面向儿童数字通信的多智能体会话沙盒
abstract: Children's peer conflicts increasingly play out in group chats, where tone and timing are stripped away, and a hurtful message is easier to send than to say aloud. We present Lilo, a multi-agent conversational system that lets children practice such conversations, so they are better prepared when they encounter them in real digital communication. In Lilo, the child joins two AI-driven peers mid-argument, coached by a mentor character, also named Lilo, through a Stop-Think-Act traffic light. Through an exploratory study with 28 children (aged 9-11), we examine how children engage with Lilo's simulated peer conflict and the mentor's traffic-light interventions. The study included an intervention with Lilo, surveys before and after the intervention, and exit interviews. Participants reported significantly higher self-efficacy for coping with unpleasant messages after their interaction with Lilo. They felt safe experimenting, knowing nothing they wrote would be held against them.
summary_zh: 儿童群体冲突常转移至群聊，因缺乏语气与时机更易发送伤人信息，需提升其应对能力。
提出多智能体会话系统 Lilo，让儿童与两个AI同伴进行冲突对话，并由导师通过红绿灯机制指导。
对28名儿童的研究表明，使用Lilo后儿童应对不愉快信息的自我效能感显著提升，且在沙盒中感到安全。

title: A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
title_zh: 自演化多模态智能体的跨场景调查与分析
abstract: Recent work shows that multimodal agents increasingly self-improve without recurring human annotation. However, each self-improvement mechanism is designed and evaluated within a single scenario, leaving its preconditions unverified under cross-scenario transfer. This survey investigates the structural source of asymmetric mechanism transfer across four scenarios: multimodal reasoning, multimodal generation, GUI and Web navigation, and embodied manipulation. We first formalize the self-evolving multimodal agent by four criteria and a differentia of self-reference, and adopt the three-stage self-evolving loop of experience generation, feedback acquisition, and update consolidation as our analytical framework to position the scenarios along ceilings on rollout count and feedback fidelity. Comparing self-evolving with fixed loops within each scenario separates the limitations that the scenario imposes from those inherent in the self-evolving design. We then recast each mechanism as a trade-off that raises a scarce factor by presupposing a task-structural resource, such as output equivalence or checkable outcomes, and judge it portable, conditional, blocked, or redundant across scenarios. We attribute the asymmetry to divergent combinations of scarce factors and resources across opposite transfer directions, and identify the matched-budget measurements that could overturn these still untested verdicts.
summary_zh: 现有自演化多模态智能体仅在单一场景内设计与评估，缺乏跨场景迁移的前提验证。
本文提出三阶段自演化循环分析框架，对比自演化与固定循环，分离场景限制与设计缺陷。
将自演化机制重铸为资源权衡，判定其跨场景可移植性，并指出不对称迁移源于稀缺因素与资源的组合差异。

title: PARLEY: Evaluating LLM Collaboration Through Cooperative Asymmetric Puzzles
title_zh: PARLEY：通过非对称合作谜题评估LLM协作
abstract: As large language models power autonomous agents, understanding how they collaborate and where they fail becomes critical. We introduce PARLEY, an extensible platform for studying LLM agent collaboration through four asymmetric puzzle tasks grounded in cognitive psychology (referential communication, joint coordination, perspective-taking, and spatial reasoning). GPT-4o agent pairs succeeded in 60.5% of conversations (N=400, 100 per task), with task-level variation (34-80%) reflecting distinct collaborative demands. From these conversations, we derived the data-driven PAC taxonomy: six failure types organized into Perception (visual interpretation and spatial reasoning), Adaptation (progress tracking and feedback integration), and Coordination (verification and grounding). Failure to incorporate external feedback was a critical indicator of unsuccessful collaboration, with agents repeatedly applying unsuccessful strategies. We also show that a taxonomy-guided intervention (N=200) improved average task success to 70.5%. These results demonstrate how PARLEY can be used to derive meaningful, data-driven insights that can in turn lead to improved agentic collaboration.
summary_zh: 【问题】需理解LLM agent协作方式及失败原因→【方法】提出PARLEY平台，含4项认知心理学非对称谜题→【结论】GPT-4o对成功率为60.5%，任务差异反映不同协作需求
【问题】需明确协作失败的具体类型→【方法】分析对话数据，提出PAC分类法→【结论】归纳出感知、适应与协调3类6种失败，未整合外部反馈是关键失败指标
【问题】需验证分类法能否指导改进协作→【方法】实施基于PAC分类法的干预实验→【结论】干预使平均任务成功率提升至70.5%，证明平台可产出有效改进洞察

title: SHARP: Semantic Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for Next POI Prediction with Dynamic Memory
title_zh: 基于语义层级代理推理与动态记忆的下一POI预测
abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) prediction supports personalized location services by anticipating users' next destinations. Recent methods leverage large language models (LLMs) for semantic reasoning and graphs for collective mobility modeling, improving POI prediction. However, three challenges still remain. Bridging LLMs' semantic reasoning and specific POI prediction remains challenging. User mobility also evolves over time, making it necessary to retain and update historical knowledge within limited LLM contexts. Meanwhile, global transition graphs smooth out time-specific category transition patterns. To address these challenges, we propose Semantic Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for Next POI Prediction with Dynamic Memory (SHARP), an agentic hierarchical framework in which category-level reasoning guides specific POI prediction. A trajectory memory agent maintains a dynamic trajectory memory bank that preserves earlier mobility patterns and tracks behavioral changes with limited context growth. We construct multi-granularity time-aware category transition graphs with global and time-conditioned views to preserve temporal regularities obscured by global aggregation. A category predict agent combines these graphs with trajectory memory to predict likely next categories. SHARP learns semantic IDs (SIDs) through a residual-quantized variational autoencoder (RQ-VAE) to construct semantic POI representations, which are jointly optimized with a category-guided POI predictor end-to-end. On three real-world datasets, SHARP improves Acc@5 and Acc@10 by an average of 5.29 and 4.52 percentage points, respectively, over the strongest baseline.
summary_zh: 现有LLM语义推理与POI预测存在鸿沟，且难以在有限上下文中更新历史知识，全局转移图也会掩盖时间特定模式。
提出SHARP框架，采用类别级推理引导POI预测，通过轨迹记忆代理维护动态记忆库以追踪行为变化。
构建多粒度时间感知类别转移图保留时间规律，结合RQ-VOAE学习语义ID，在三个数据集上显著超越基线。

title: Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class: A Policed Quality-of-Service Mechanism for Agentic AI Traffic, Evaluated from Simulation to Real-Kernel Adversarial Testing
title_zh: 可验证智能体流量类：一种面向智能体AI流量的QoS机制
abstract: Software agents built on large language models generate traffic unlike human web traffic, yet routers have no class for it and cannot verify a sender's claim to be an agent. This paper proposes the Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class (VATC), which combines a reserved Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value declaring agent traffic, a router-side classifier that demotes flows contradicting the declaration to a class served after best-effort traffic, and a rate-limited priority queue. VATC was compared with static Differentiated Services (DiffServ), a dedicated class that trusts the marking, and fq_codel, a per-flow fair-queuing scheduler, in two simulators and on a real Linux kernel. VATC matched DiffServ under steady load. In a constructed burst it cut mean agent queuing delay by 98% relative to DiffServ in simulation (assuming an immediate verdict), at a 12% increase in human delay; most of the gain came from the separate class. Under a spoofed flood in the kernel, the rate limit held human latency 11 times below DiffServ's. Without verification, DiffServ and a tightly configured fq_codel gave legitimate agents lower latency than VATC; a live four-feature classifier then demoted all 20 bulk-shaped spoofers and gave agents 0.30 ms, but missed six spoofers that copied the agent pattern. With emulated network delay, a timing feature of the classifier stopped separating agent from human flows. In real agent harnesses on a congested link, router queueing took 13% to 63% of task time, depending on harness and assumed model latency. The traffic was synthetic or sandbox-scale.
summary_zh: 现有路由器无法区分和验证LLM智能体流量，本文提出可验证智能体流量类（VATC）机制，结合保留DSCP声明、路由器侧分类器及限速优先队列来管理该流量。
在稳态下VATC匹配DiffServ性能；突发流量下，VATC使智能体排队延迟降低98%（人类延迟增12%）；内核欺骗洪泛下，限速使人类延迟比DiffServ低11倍。
无验证时DiffServ等机制延迟更低；加入分类器可降级大部分欺骗者，但会漏判模仿者且受网络延迟影响。真实拥塞链路中，路由排队占任务时间13%至63%。
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 15 tables; submitted to IEEE Access; code and data at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23865136

title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
title_zh: Tree-Ising：基于比特级Ising编辑修复语言模型
abstract: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights. Forward statistics define an objective that weakens a loop direction, strengthens a concluding direction, and preserves the layer's output on productive tokens. Within a state-tree representation, where lossless BF16 storage acts as a special case, the admissible edits are sign flips and exponent shifts that preserve all shared group exponents and mantissas. We decompose this objective exactly into independent QUBO (Ising) problems, one per output row, which we solve on a GPU using simulated annealing or quantum-inspired simulated bifurcation. On the agent's two layers, Tree-Ising achieves 54.6% on MATH-500, outperforming the agent's edit (51.7%) under the same evaluation protocol, while the base model scores 7.9% as reported. The simulated bifurcation solver yields a statistically indistinguishable repair at 55.1%. Both solvers outperform the agent edit across all five math benchmarks, with statistically significant improvements on MATH-500 and GSM8K after correcting for multiple comparisons. Our approach modifies 13% to 17% fewer weights and reduces BF16 bit flips by a factor of 2.2 to 2.3. It requires only four forward-pass requests and zero LLM tokens, with the annealing recipe costing about $0.90 in GPU time. On Qwen3.5-2B, with layers and dose selected using only the base model, the same recipe increases greedy GSM8K accuracy from 21.6% to 69.4%. As a proof of concept, we execute an eight-variable repair subproblem using QAOA on an IBM Heron processor.
summary_zh: 前沿LLM代理修复模型存在消耗大量token和请求的问题，本文提出Tree-Ising方法，将其转化为BF16权重上的稀疏离散优化问题。
该方法利用前向统计定义目标，将可容许的比特编辑在状态树表示下精确分解为独立的QUBO（Ising）问题，并用模拟退火或模拟分岔求解。
在MATH-500等基准上，该方法准确率显著优于代理编辑，修改权重更少、比特翻转减半，且仅需4次前向请求和零LLM token。

title: Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout
title_zh: 自回归多步推理在集中与分散注意力头丢失下的崩溃
abstract: During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter $\mathcal{B}=0.10$ (scheduling $\sim 5.7\%$ of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from $91.2\%$ under diffuse noise to $78.8\%$ under burst dropout ($Δ= -12.4$ percentage points [pp], exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from $84.0\%$ to $76.8\%$ ($Δ= -7.2$ pp, $p = 0.0198$). Conversely, dispersing the identical cumulative budget uniformly across generation steps via stratified quintile matching yields substantially milder degradation (retaining $91.2\%$ in Qwen and $84.0\%$ in LLaMA). In an exploratory factorial dissociation ($N=100$), single-step dropout density is associated with an acute drop in a single schedule draw ($-10.0$ pp on Qwen, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.0425$), while multi-token continuity exhibits an inconclusive compounding trend ($-7.0$ pp, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.1892$). Error analysis reveals that Qwen failures reflect derivation errors within formatted responses (conditional accuracy drop of $-11.4$ pp), whereas in LLaMA $22.2\%$ of discordant losses lack a final answer format line (conditional gap narrows to $-5.0$ pp). These findings demonstrate that autoregressive reasoning chains are particularly vulnerable to concentrated structural disruptions, providing empirical benchmarks for fault tolerance in transformer architectures.
summary_zh: 【问题】探究类脑局部神经元静息的集中式干扰如何影响LLM的序列推理。【方法】在GSM8K上对比集中式注意力头掩蔽与等量分散式dropout。【结论】集中式干扰导致模型准确率显著下降，而分散式影响轻微。
【问题】单步dropout密度与多token连续性哪个更导致推理崩溃？【方法】对Qwen模型进行探索性因子分离实验（N=100）。【结论】单步dropout密度与准确率急剧下降显著相关，多token连续性的累积效应趋势不明确。
【问题】集中式dropout导致不同模型推理失败的错误模式有何差异？【方法】对Qwen和LLaMA的错误进行条件准确率与格式分析。【结论】Qwen多因推导错误失败，LLaMA多因缺失最终答案格式行失败。

title: Performance Portability Explained: Insights from accelerating ICON microphysics
title_zh: 性能可移植性解析：加速ICON微物理过程的启示
abstract: Scientific computing is under increasing pressure to adapt to HPC hardware that is shaped by AI workloads. In these modern ecosystems, extracting reasonable performance without investing major engineering effort is a central issue for domain scientists. Correctness constraints and intricate reference implementations represent further impediments to development. Instead of using a double-precision implementation as a reference, considering the underlying scientific problem directly opens more opportunities for performance improvements when updating and rewriting applications. We take seven different portability frameworks---covering pragma-based, DSL, and data-centric approaches---and evaluate them on a microphysics kernel of the ICON climate model. Our performance benchmarks show that each different HPC system benefits from a different combination of optimizations, so we develop the measure of framework expressivity to gauge how easily each framework can customize portable implementations in this way.
summary_zh: 科学计算面临适应AI驱动的HPC硬件压力，且正确性约束与复杂参考实现阻碍了性能优化。
直接从底层科学问题出发而非依赖双精度参考实现，为应用重写与更新提供更多性能优化机会。
评估7种可移植框架在ICON气候模型微物理核上的表现，提出框架表达性度量以评估定制优化能力。

title: CFGKAT: A Complete Calculus for Non-Local Control Flow
title_zh: CFGKAT：非局部控制流的完备演算
abstract: CFGKAT is an extension of guarded Kleene Algebra with Tests (GKAT) that adds non-local control flow (e.g., break, goto) while maintaining an efficient decision procedure. An axiomatization of equivalence for CFGKAT presents unique barriers created by the presence of non-local control flow and contextual semantics of goto which compromises compositional reasoning. In this paper, we overcome these barriers and present a sound and complete axiomatization of program equivalence in CFGKAT. We verify the loop case of the Erosa-Hendren goto elimination algorithm, a difficult syntactic metatheorem which requires reasoning about fixpoints, control-flow contexts, and mutable state. We mechanize the metatheory and case study in Rocq.
summary_zh: 现有GKAT无法处理break和goto等非局部控制流，且goto的上下文语义破坏了组合推理。
本文提出CFGKAT扩展，克服了上述障碍，给出了程序等价性的可靠且完备的公理化。
在Rocq中机械化验证了元理论与Erosa-Hendren goto消除算法的循环情况。

title: From Search to Decision: How Post-Training Shapes Information-Seeking Capabilities in Large Language Models
title_zh: 后训练如何塑造大语言模型的信息搜寻能力
abstract: Information seeking in large language model (LLM) systems increasingly involves decisions about when to acquire information, where to search, and how to evaluate and use evidence. Recent post-training methods have improved several such behaviors, but their objectives and evaluations span different tasks and system settings. This paper organizes research around six interrelated information-seeking capabilities and examines the learning signals, optimization methods, update loci, and credit-assignment mechanisms used to develop them. We synthesize empirical progress in targeted behaviors, end-to-end performance, search control, and generalization. Existing studies report gains in retrieval routing, query refinement, multi-tool exploration, evidence-grounded reasoning, and resource-aware search, although the scope of behavioral evidence varies across capabilities. We identify open challenges in estimating prospective retrieval utility, coordinating information-seeking decisions, and adapting to unfamiliar retrieval environments, and discuss evaluation practices for interpreting future progress.
summary_zh: LLM系统的信息搜寻涉及何时获取、何处搜索及如何评估证据，但现有后训练方法的目标与评估缺乏统一组织。
本文围绕六项信息搜寻能力，系统审查了学习信号、优化方法、更新位置与信用分配机制。
研究综合了检索路由等行为的经验进展，并指出预估检索效用与适应未知环境等开放挑战。

title: Right for the Wrong Reasons? Evaluating Plausibility and Behavioral Change in Explanation-Guided Learning
title_zh: 解释引导学习中的合理性与行为改变评估
abstract: Explanation-Guided Learning (EGL) promises models that are not only accurate but also rely on task-relevant evidence. However, whether improved agreement between model explanations and human-provided rationales also implies a changed decision strategy remains unclear. We study this tension under controlled synthetic shortcut introduction using a constructed shortcut dataset. Inspired by real-world applications, our benchmark covers shortcuts of different kinds, including localized, background-based, and global cues. This allows us to evaluate whether different EGL objectives produce behavioral changesand explanatory changes. Across these axes, we find that the effects of EGL are strongly objective-specific. Rationale-based data augmentation provides the clearest robustness gains when shortcut evidence can be separated from task-relevant foreground information, reaching average accuracy improvements of up to +4.8 percentage points (pp) together with increased foreground reliance. Attribution-constraining objectives primarily improve explanation plausibility, increasing Importance Mass by up to +14 pp on average, but provide weaker and less consistent behavioral correction, with average accuracy gains of at most +1.6 pp. Moreover, neither improved robustness nor improved plausibility reliably implies higher perturbation-based fidelity. Overall, our results show that EGL can be useful, but its success cannot be inferred from rationale agreement alone and should instead be evaluated along complementary behavioral and explanation-level axes. We publicly release all experimental results to enable further analysis (https://right-for-wrong-reasons.dfki.de/).
summary_zh: 解释引导学习（EGL）旨在提升模型准确性与证据可靠性，但模型解释与人类依据的契合度提升是否意味着决策策略改变尚不明确。
构建含局部、背景和全局捷径的合成数据集，评估不同EGL目标在行为和解释层面的改变效果。
EGL效果高度依赖目标：数据增强能提升鲁棒性（准确率+4.8pp），归因约束仅提升解释合理性（+14pp）但行为修正弱；合理性提升不代表保真度提高，需多维度评估。
comment: Accepted at EXPLAINS 2026 (Best Student Paper Award). Pre-review manuscript

title: Hierarchical Graph Representation Learning with Pooling-Induced Substructures
title_zh: 基于池化诱导子结构的层次图表示学习
abstract: Hierarchical graph-level tasks that require reasoning over substructures that extend beyond local neighborhoods are posing challenges for standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). While graph pooling aims to address this by coarsening graphs into hierarchical representations, existing methods often fail to explicitly preserve the substructures they induce, leading to inconsistent empirical performance. Moreover, evaluating such approaches remains challenging due to the lack of benchmarks with explicit hierarchical structure. We propose Pooled-Substructure-Aware GNNs, an approach to graph pooling that explicitly preserves and processes substructures uncovered by structure-based pooling schemes. We show that this design enhances the expressive power of pooling-based GNNs in the sense of the Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) test. To enable principled evaluation, we introduce two new synthetic datasets with controllable hierarchical structure and propose a metric to characterize the prevalence of hierarchical patterns in real-world graph-level benchmarks. On tasks with relevant hierarchical structure, our approach outperforms matched pooling baselines, while remaining competitive on structurally simpler benchmarks. Code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/lsbicego/PSA-GNN/.
summary_zh: 标准GNN难以处理需超越局部子结构推理的层次图任务，现有图池化方法未显式保留其诱导的子结构，导致性能不稳定。
提出Pooled-Substructure-Aware GNN，显式保留并处理基于结构的池化方案所揭示的子结构，提升了基于池化GNN的WL测试表达能力。
构建两个可控层次结构的合成数据集并提出评估指标，在相关任务上优于匹配基线，在简单任务上保持竞争力。

title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
title_zh: Hx2Dx：面向LLM对话式临床推理的多模态基准
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve expert-level diagnostic accuracy in static evaluations, where the model receives a curated vignette or case report that already condenses the diagnostically relevant findings. Such evaluations measure inference over already selected evidence; the evaluations do not account for the inquiry used to obtain it. In clinical practice, however, diagnosis is an iterative process of inquiry. Clinicians take the patient's history, or anamnesis (Hx), through targeted questioning, examine the patient, and request and interpret tests, progressively narrowing the differential until they reach a final diagnosis (Dx). We introduce Hx2Dx ARENA, an interactive benchmark of 1'000 clinical cases from the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM). Each case is a simulated encounter that proceeds from initial presentation through history taking and physical examination to diagnostic workup. We evaluate open- and closed-source LLMs under multiple configurations. Performance varies considerably across models in the interactive setting, and every model loses diagnostic accuracy relative to the static setting, where the full case is presented upfront. The ability to ask the right questions accounts for much of both the gap between models and the loss of accuracy: diagnosis improves as questions become more targeted and build a more complete clinical picture. LLMs thus reason well once the relevant data are available but remain limited in hypothesis-driven information gathering, in knowing what to ask in order to know. Closing this gap is a prerequisite for their safe integration into real-world diagnostic workflows.
summary_zh: 现有LLM临床诊断评估多基于静态病历，忽略了临床实践中通过交互式问诊获取证据的动态过程。
提出Hx2Dx ARENA基准，包含1000个NEJM模拟病例，评估LLM从病史采集到最终诊断的交互推理能力。
交互式评估下所有模型诊断准确率均下降，主因是假设驱动的信息收集能力不足；提升提问针对性是关键。

title: ProofCoder: Continuous Reasoning for Automated Software Verification
title_zh: ProofCoder：面向自动软件验证的连续推理系统
abstract: Formal verification using proof assistants provides strong correctness guarantees for software, but constructing proofs remains labor-intensive and requires significant expertise. Recent approaches based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating proof synthesis. However, these approaches typically constrain the model to a rigid tactic-generation loop, in which the surrounding system controls premise retrieval, proof-state management, and backtracking. We introduce ProofCoder, an agentic proof-synthesis system for Rocq that approaches theorem proving from a coding-agent perspective. Rather than generating tactics within a fixed loop, ProofCoder reasons continuously throughout proof search and uses proof-assistant feedback to decide when to gather additional information, inspect proof states, revise previously generated proof fragments, or backtrack to an earlier point in the proof. This allows it to iteratively construct, repair, and refine proofs, at either tactic-level or whole-proof granularity. We evaluate ProofCoder on 280 challenging verification tasks from the AutoRocq Benchmark. On the best-performing configurations, ProofCoder increases proof success from 47% to 60% over the state-of-theart AutoRocq system, corresponding to a 27.7% relative improvement at approximately half the cost. Our ablations identify continuous reasoning as a key design choice: without it, the agent solves fewer lemmas at substantially higher cost, backtracks four to six times more often, and more frequently discards its own revisions. Whole-proof and tactic-level generation achieve similar success rates but follow distinct search and repair strategies. These results suggest that effective automated software verification requires more than improved tactic selection: continuous reasoning and feedback-guided proof revision are critical ingredients for robust proof synthesis.
summary_zh: 现有LLM自动化证明方法受限于固定循环，缺乏灵活的回溯与状态管理能力。
提出ProofCoder系统，采用coding-agent视角实现连续推理，根据反馈动态收集信息、检查状态、修复或回溯证明片段。
在AutoRocq基准上，证明成功率相对提升27.7%且成本减半；消融实验证实连续推理是关键，大幅减少回溯与丢弃率。

title: Mobility-Aware Task Offloading in Mobile Edge Computing-Empowered Space-Air-Ground Integrated Internet-of-Things Networks
title_zh: 移动边缘计算赋能的空天地物联网移动感知任务卸载
abstract: Mobile edge computing (MEC)-empowered spaceair-ground integrated Internet-of-Things (IoT) networks (SAGIINs) provide a promising solution for computation-intensive tasks generated by mobile IoT devices (IDs). However, task offloading in SAGIINs is challenging due to time-varying IDto-unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) channels, intermittent LEO satellite service availability, and the coupling among UAV trajectory, communication, computation, and energy decisions. This paper investigates an energy-efficient task offloading and UAV trajectory planning problem in an MEC-empowered SAGIIN, where one UAV acts as both an aerial relay and an MEC server, and multiple LEO satellites provide supplementary computing resources. The UAV trajectory planning, task splitting, and computing resource allocation are jointly optimized to minimize the total system energy consumption under task completion, communication, computation, flight region, and satellite service window constraints. The resulting non-convex problem is decomposed into a UAV trajectory planning subproblem and a task splitting and computing resource allocation subproblem. To solve the former, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-assisted large language model (LLM)-enhanced deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm, termed RLD, is proposed. The latter is shown to be convex and can be solved by using CVXPY for a given UAV trajectory. A weighted retrieval score is further designed to balance ID mobility-pattern similarity and historical UAV trajectory energy performance. Simulation results show that RLD completes all computational tasks in previously unseen test scenarios while consuming less total energy than the benchmark algorithms.
summary_zh: 空天地物联网中，设备移动性及卫星间歇服务导致任务卸载与UAV轨迹等决策高度耦合且难以优化。
联合优化UAV轨迹、任务分割与计算资源分配，以最小化系统能耗，并将非凸问题分解为轨迹与资源分配两个子问题。
提出RAG辅助LLM增强的DDPG算法求解轨迹子问题，资源子问题用CVXPY求解；实验表明该算法在新场景下能完成所有任务且能耗更低。

title: What a CAGE 4 Score Measures: An Audit of a Learned Cyber-Defense Benchmark, Its Reference Defenders, and the Tables Built on Them
title_zh: CAGE 4 得分度量审计：学习型网络防御基准及参考防御者
abstract: CAGE Challenge 4 is the benchmark on which learned multi-agent cyber defenders are compared. We reproduce its two reference defenders, KEEP and H-MARL Expert, in a pinned container and show that three things read from it measure less than they are taken to measure. First, the simulator silently discards any action asserted for an agent whose previous action is still running, and charges one point for a discarded Restore as for one that runs. The documented observation does not expose the busy flag. Both reference defenders read it in their own wrappers, and switching that check off at evaluation costs KEEP's released policy 99.58 points per episode and H-MARL's 145.98, in both cases the charge for Restores sent to busy agents, with H-MARL's executed actions unchanged step for step. On a supervisory harness, holding interventions until the agent is idle is worth 25.3 and 27.6 points per episode at the published setting. In training, the check decides how a busy step enters the trajectory. Trained without it, KEEP leads at a hundred updates in all four paired seeds and trails from two hundred on in all four. Continued to two thousand updates on three seeds, the repaired recipe ends inside the released interval on one seed and short on two, by 27 and 125 points, a spread across training seeds far wider than the released reproduction interval. Second, the evaluation seeds the environment but not the policy, so a reported mean is one draw, and 88.9% of per-episode outcome variance is the policy's own sampling draw. Third, recovery precision depends on the truth it is scored against. Across five published comparison tables, none states the artifact, sampling, criterion and adversary that would make its numbers comparable. We release the instrument, our patches to both defenders, the traces and checkpoints behind every number, and a five-item disclosure checklist.
summary_zh: CAGE 4 基准存在动作丢弃计分缺陷，修复该问题后参考防御者 KEEP 和 H-MARL 得分显著下降，且训练轨迹改变导致结果方差远超复现区间。
基准评估仅对环境种子固定而未固定策略采样，导致 88.9% 的回合结果方差源于策略自身的随机采样。
恢复精度取决于评分基准真值，但现有五张对比表均未声明使数据可比的工件、采样、标准及对手等关键信息。
comment: 47 pages. Code at https://github.com/jrice-ai/cage (tag arxiv-v1), data at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23681828

title: Isolation Is Not Confidentiality: Security Boundaries of Geometric Access Control in RAG
title_zh: 隔离不等于机密性：RAG几何访问控制的安全边界
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly rely on vector databases containing documents governed by different access-control policies. Recent search-preserving geometric approaches enforce such access control by structuring the embedding space so that transformed embeddings, which we call protected representations, remain retrievable without exposing information across policy boundaries. We provide a unified security analysis of this paradigm, covering policy isolation, representation confidentiality, query forgery resistance, and policy-membership hiding. We consider both a curious cloud service provider observing the protected representations stored in the vector database and a curious user holding aligned pairs of original embeddings and protected representations. Evaluating the available implementations of the works proposing these geometric transformation mechanisms across three encoders, we find that geometric transformations preserve retrieval utility and provide strong policy isolation, but do not provide the other security properties. A curious user can recover the original embeddings from a few hundred pairs and forge policy-compatible queries at a higher cost that grows with encoder dimension for secret per-policy transformations. Moreover, policy-dependent geometry can leak policy membership even when unauthorized retrieval is prevented. These results show that policy isolation, confidentiality, forgery resistance, and membership hiding are distinct security objectives.
summary_zh: RAG系统采用几何变换实现访问控制，需统一分析其策略隔离、表示机密性、查询伪造抵抗及策略成员隐藏等安全属性。
针对好奇的云服务商和用户，评估现有几何变换机制，发现其虽保持检索效用与策略隔离，但不具备其他安全属性。
好奇用户可还原原始嵌入并伪造查询，策略几何会泄露成员信息，证明隔离、机密性等是截然不同的安全目标。

title: LaST0.5: A Generalist World Action Model with Interaction-Centric Latent Reasoning
title_zh: LaST0.5：基于交互中心潜推理的通用世界动作模型
abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, endowing policies with strong capabilities for modeling temporal and physical dynamics. Existing WAMs, encompassing both video-first action prediction and joint video-action modeling, directly transfer global physical representations from world models to action generation. However, global scene representations may underemphasize local robot-object interactions, creating a mismatch between representations optimized for world evolution and those required for manipulation. To bridge this gap, we propose LaST0.5, a novel WAM that introduces an interaction-centric physical representation between world modeling and action generation. Specifically, LaST0.5 learns a compact interaction-centric latent space under the supervision of visual interaction cues between the robot and the environment. This reasoning space is instantiated as a latent expert that bridges the world expert and the action expert within a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Furthermore, LaST0.5 performs adaptive world-to-action transfer by jointly predicting future representations and progress values, using progress consistency to adjust action execution and trigger future resampling. Finally, we pretrain LaST0.5 on a large-scale robotic data corpus comprising over 14k hours of data, establishing interaction-centric physical reasoning as a scalable and effective paradigm. LaST0.5 achieves 99.5% on LIBERO, surpasses the previous state of the art on ten evaluated RLBench tasks, and demonstrates robust long-horizon execution and precise dexterous manipulation in real-world experiments.
summary_zh: 现有世界动作模型的全局表征易忽略局部机器人-物体交互，导致世界演化与动作生成表征失配。
提出LaST0.5，在视觉交互监督下学习紧凑的交互中心潜空间，作为潜专家桥接世界与动作专家。
该模型在LIBERO达99.5%，RLBench十项任务超SOTA，并在真实实验中展现稳健的长时序与灵巧操作能力。

title: Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution
title_zh: 基于程序辅助的可修补技能演化框架
abstract: Agent skills have emerged as an effective means of enabling LLM agents to solve complex, interactive tasks by encoding reusable knowledge without modifying model parameters. Recent approaches further improve skill adaptation by distilling reusable experience from agent execution trajectories and evolving skills based on downstream task feedback. However, existing methods primarily represent skills as natural language documents, intertwining procedural logic with descriptive knowledge and making skills difficult to maintain and evolve. To address this limitation, we propose PASE (Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution), a program-aided framework that iteratively evolves skills by associating them with executable programs. Unlike prior approaches that encode trajectory-derived experience primarily in natural language, PASE separates reusable procedural logic into editable programs, enabling targeted updates to executable components while reducing the need to repeatedly revise natural language skills. Extensive experiments across diverse models and benchmarks demonstrate that PASE consistently outperforms all baselines, by achieving over 2.8% improvements. Further analyses show that PASE exhibits greater evolutionary stability and generalisation capability, highlighting the critical role of programmatic knowledge in skill evolution. We will release all data and code via GitHub.
summary_zh: 现有LLM agent技能以自然语言表示，逻辑与描述交织，难以维护和演化。
提出PASE框架，将可复用过程逻辑分离为可编辑程序，实现针对性修补。
实验表明PASE性能提升超2.8%，且具有更高的演化稳定性和泛化能力。

title: Interleaving anatomical inspection and diagnostic reasoning for explainable radiology report generation
title_zh: 基于解剖检查与诊断推理交织的可解释放射报告生成
abstract: Automated radiology report generation can draft clinically plausible reports, yet the pathway from visual evidence to reported findings remains opaque, leaving the diagnostic basis of these reports unexplained and the generated reports difficult to review or revise. We introduce ARIVE (Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence), an explainable report generation framework that interleaves anatomical inspection with diagnostic reasoning prior to final report composition. To support this process, we constructed 159,416 multimodal chain-of-thought (MCoT) trajectories from MIMIC-CXR, wherein visual evidence from inspected anatomical regions informs subsequent clinical interpretation. Trained on these trajectories and further optimized using anatomical and clinical-content rewards, ARIVE achieved superior clinical-efficacy performance compared with strong baselines on MIMIC-CXR and the abnormality-centered MIMIC-ABN. ARIVE's reports were competitive with those of leading models in blinded expert grading, and its MCoT trajectories earned high ratings for diagnostic traceability. Furthermore, a paired review evaluation suggests that access to MCoT can aid in identifying errors within generated reports.
summary_zh: 现有自动放射报告生成从视觉到结果的路径不透明，缺乏诊断依据且难以审查修改。
提出ARIVE框架，将解剖检查与诊断推理交织，并构建15.9万条多模态思维链轨迹作为支撑。
ARIVE在临床效能上优于基线，其思维链轨迹获高诊断可追溯性评分，且有助于人工发现报告错误。

title: Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: 编码Agent记忆后训练II：通过同策略蒸馏释放文件操作记忆潜力
abstract: Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model's active context. They must therefore decide what to write down and what to read back, and when to do either. Recent work has begun to use on-policy distillation (OPD) to make memory control part of the policy, relying on memory tools and compaction protocols that lie outside either model's pre-training. However, this weakens the distillation on both sides: the teacher cannot give useful guidance on an interface it has never used, and the student samples too few meaningful memory actions for that guidance to take effect. To study this problem, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym II (CAMG-II), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, AutoResearch, General, and Visual. Alongside each environment's native task interface, CAMG-II provides ordinary Bash access and an episode-persistent workspace, enabling the policy to create, revise, search, and reuse files as memory across context replacements. We also introduce Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II (CAMP-II), which trains a single policy jointly across all five environments with fully asynchronous OPD to learn this file-based memory behavior directly from a frozen teacher with a prior for file operations. On CAMG-II, CAMP-II obtains 2.97 times the gain of the strongest OPD baseline. The memory behavior CAMP-II learns generalizes to two external benchmarks, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, with improved success rates.
summary_zh: 长交互任务超出LLM上下文时，需控制记忆读写，但现有同策略蒸馏（OPD）因记忆接口脱离预训练而效果受限。
提出CAMG-II环境套件，提供Bash访问与持久工作区，使Agent能通过文件创建、检索与复用来实现跨上下文记忆。
提出CAMP-II方法，利用异步OPD联合训练策略，从具备文件操作先验的冻结教师学习记忆行为，性能达基线2.97倍且泛化至外部基准。

title: Specify Privacy Yourself: Assessing Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Preservation Ability of Large Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 大视觉语言模型的推理时个性化隐私保护能力评估
abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities but raise significant privacy concerns due to their abilities to infer sensitive personal information from images with high precision. While current LVLMs are relatively well aligned to protect universal privacy, e.g., credit card data, we argue that privacy is inherently personalized and context-dependent. This work pivots towards a novel task: can LVLMs achieve Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Protection (ITP$^3$), allowing users to dynamically specify privacy boundaries through language specifications? To this end, we present SPY-Bench, the first systematic assessment of ITP$^3$ ability, which comprises (1) 32,700 unique samples with image-question pairs and personalized privacy instructions across 67 categories and 24 real-world scenarios, and (2) novel metrics grounded in user specifications and context awareness. Benchmarking the ITP$^3$ ability of 21 SOTA LVLMs, we reveal that: (i) most models, even the top-performing o4-mini, perform poorly, with only $\sim$24% compliance accuracy; (ii) they show quite limited contextual privacy understanding capability. Therefore, we implemented initial ITP$^3$ alignment methods, including a novel Noise Contrastive Alignment variant which achieves 96.88% accuracy while maintaining reasonable general performance. These results mark an initial step towards the ethical deployment of more controllable LVLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/achernarwang/specify-privacy-yourself
summary_zh: LVLMs易从图像推断敏感信息，现有对齐仅保护通用隐私，未考虑隐私的个性化与上下文依赖性。
提出推理时个性化隐私保护任务，构建SPY-Bench基准，含3.27万样本及基于用户规范的新指标。
评估21个SOTA模型发现合规准确率极低，提出噪声对比对齐变体，将准确率提至96.88%。
comment: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2025 (Brave New Ideas track)

title: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
title_zh: BioXArena-Pro：面向自主生物医学机器学习智能体的研究级基准
abstract: Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.
summary_zh: 现有生物医学编码智能体基准规模小、近饱和且存数据泄露，故构建BioXArena-Pro基准。
该基准含8个领域64项研究级任务，保留完整生物单元作测试集，并经多轮AI与人工审计。
实验表明智能体整体表现远未饱和；适应新数据、智能体框架与预训练基础模型均对性能至关重要。
comment: 51 pages (22 main text, 29 supplementary information), 5 figures, 7 supplementary tables. Code: https://github.com/mbzuai-ai4bio/BioXArena-Pro ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mbzuai-ai4bio/BioXArena-Pro-Public ; Leaderboard: https://mbzuai-ai4bio.github.io/BioXArena-Pro/

title: Controlled Knowledge Engineering for Taxonomy Induction with Tool-Grounded LLM Agents and Runtime-Adaptive Policies
title_zh: 基于工具接地LLM代理与运行时自适应策略的分类体系构建
abstract: Taxonomies are structured knowledge representations that support semantic search, recommendation, product catalog organization, and retrieval-augmented generation. Their automated construction from a fixed set of candidate entities requires more than plausible text generation: the resulting hierarchy must be complete, structurally valid, and semantically coherent. Large Language Models (LLMs) are promising for this task, but iterative free-form generation remains vulnerable to omitted or hallucinated entities, invalid hierarchical relations, and inconsistent organizational principles. We introduce TIGA (Taxonomy Induction with Tool-Grounded Agents), a knowledge-engineering architecture that formulates taxonomy induction as an iterative decision process over an explicit state and constrained action space. TIGA combines executable taxonomy-editing tools, an memory that records tool calls, rationales, and outcomes, and a runtime-adaptive organizational policy that the agent revises during inference. An optional global reviewer evaluates the constructed taxonomy against the candidate set and the active policy. We evaluate TIGA on four benchmark taxonomies using two LLM backbones and compare it with single-shot and iterative prompting-based baselines. TIGA achieves the strongest structural-quality results in most evaluated configurations, but does not dominate on every precision measure. The gains are accompanied by substantially higher token consumption, API-call volume, and inference time. Ablation results show consistent benefits from the policy and interaction-memory components, whereas the effect of global review depends on the dataset and the available revision budget. These findings characterize tool grounding and runtime policy adaptation as promising but costly mechanisms for improving the controlled construction of structured knowledge representations.
summary_zh: LLM迭代生成分类体系易出现实体遗漏、幻觉及结构无效问题，需严格约束。
提出TIGA架构，将分类构建转为受限动作空间的决策过程，结合编辑工具、交互记忆与运行时自适应策略。
TIGA在多数配置下结构质量最优，但消耗更多资源；消融实验证实策略与记忆组件有效，全局审查效果视数据集而定。
comment: Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems. Code: https://github.com/bschaarmann/TIGA

title: TreeAgent: Structure-Aware Memory Agent for Processing Long Hierarchical Data
title_zh: TreeAgent：处理长层级数据的结构感知记忆Agent
abstract: Practical Web applications increasingly require agents to interpret long conversations or documents. For inputs exceeding the context windows of large language models (LLMs), memory agents process segments sequentially and retain past information in bounded memory. However, they typically divide inputs into flat token segments without preserving structure or hierarchy, causing three limitations for structured data such as API responses or HTML documents. First, fixed-length segmentation can split fields of the same record, breaking their relationships. Second, segments lack hierarchical information, obscuring their structural context and positions. Third, successive memory updates may discard details of earlier sibling records needed for reasoning on later segments. To address these limitations, we propose TreeAgent, a structure-aware agent that uses the input hierarchy to guide both segment-wise context processing and access to past information. Specifically, TreeAgent constructs segments from complete subtrees and groups of adjacent sibling subtrees to preserve local structural relationships. We provide theoretical guarantees on segment counts to guide token budget selection toward matching the segment count of fixed-length segmentation. We further attach structural paths to the segments for the agent to identify their ancestors and hierarchical positions. We also introduce residual memory links from the segments of low-level children to the segments of high-level parents, enabling direct information flows beyond successive memory updates. We evaluate TreeAgent with four representative memory agents on eight retrieval and aggregation tasks. The inputs are derived from real-world application data in JSON, HTML, YAML, and JavaScript and range from 8K to 1M tokens. TreeAgent improves the average score across the four datasets for all four agents, with 3.61% performance gain on average.
summary_zh: 现有记忆Agent对长输入做扁平切分，破坏结构化数据记录关系、丢失层级上下文且易遗忘兄弟节点细节。
提出TreeAgent，利用输入层级指导分段与记忆访问，按完整子树及相邻兄弟子树分段以保留局部结构。
引入结构路径标识层级位置，并建立残差记忆链接实现跨层级信息直通，在8项任务上优于基线Agent。
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/ZJU-LLM-Safety/TreeAgent

title: MEOW: Medical Open-World Interactive Segmentation
title_zh: MEOW：医学开放世界交互式分割框架
