Removing the analytical learner model lowers both prediction and success, and under misleading learner profiles none of the 48 candidate skills passes admission. When DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Gemini-3.8-Flash exchange libraries, each performs better with its own. Saved libraries keep average gains of up to 11.1 points after the teacher leaves. The benefit depends on a student that can follow instructions and a deployment route that delivers them.
summary_zh: 固定工具与预算的LLM代理存在差异，通用教学过程易耗尽弱模型预算，需针对学生模型进行定制化教学。
提出SAT方法：教师构建含假设的学习者模型，用诊断探针测试假设，并为诊断出的失败编写可复用技能。
SAT使弱模型任务成功率提升至86.46%，显著优于无画像教师与未教学基线；技能库具专属性且可持久增益。

title: Autonomous Optimization of Numerical Algorithms by an AI Agent: Application to Atomistic Simulation
title_zh: AI Agent自主优化原子模拟数值算法
abstract: Coding agents built on large language models, run in automated improvement loops, can discover more efficient algorithms. We present AIOA, a framework that brings this approach to the numerical algorithms of atomistic simulation: an agent improves an algorithm against a pre-specified metric in a loop guarded by verifiers it cannot alter. Applied to ASE, a widely used atomistic simulation library, AIOA targets two facets of an algorithm: its implementation, rewritten to run faster with unchanged results, and the method itself, redesigned to converge with fewer force evaluations. Agents made six kernels 22-24 times faster on average in Python with NumPy and SciPy. On unseen problems, optimizers from the best configuration needed 3.1-3.4 times fewer force evaluations than L-BFGS for structure relaxation and 4.6-17 times fewer than standard climbing-image nudged elastic band calculations for reaction paths. The agents' optimizers also contain two algorithmic components we did not find in the literature.
summary_zh: 数值算法优化耗时，提出AIOA框架，让AI Agent在验证器监督下循环优化算法，实现自主改进。
针对原子模拟库ASE，Agent重写实现以加速运行，并重新设计方法以减少力评估次数。
Agent使6个核心提速22-24倍，新优化器在结构弛豫和反应路径计算中远优于传统算法，并发现新算法组件。
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 1 table; Supplementary Information included

title: DOBB: Dynamic Oriented Bounding Boxes for Multi-Agent Collision Avoidance under State Uncertainty and Heterogeneous Dynamics
title_zh: 多智能体碰撞避障的动态有向包围盒DOBB
abstract: Learning-based decentralized collision avoidance must remain reliable under state-estimation uncertainty and heterogeneous agent dynamics. Existing methods typically address these factors through training-domain variation or by exposing uncertainty and capability estimates to the policy at runtime. However, both leave the policy to infer how these quantities should alter the physical separation required for safe interaction, which can couple collision-avoidance behavior to relationships learned from the training distribution. We introduce the Dynamic Oriented Bounding Box (DOBB), an online geometric representation that maps the current state estimate, uncertainty, and agent-specific response characteristics into a dynamic, direction-dependent safety margin. We derive geometric features that jointly characterize the relative configuration and severity of interactions between agents' DOBBs, along with a reward function that preserves the physical interpretation of those interactions. Across four evaluation environments, DOBB achieves the lowest mean total failure rate of 2.6%. This performance persists under out-of-distribution shifts in actuation dynamics and state-estimation uncertainty, with collision-based failure remaining at or below 2.3% in every tested condition. We attribute this robustness to the geometric abstraction of the safety margin, which is less coupled to the specific uncertainty and actuation regimes encountered during training.
summary_zh: 现有去中心化避障方法难以处理状态不确定与异构动态，易使安全间距受训练分布耦合影响。
提出动态有向包围盒DOBB，将状态估计、不确定性与响应特性映射为方向相关的动态安全边界。
DOBB在四类环境中平均失败率仅2.6%，且在分布外动态与不确定性下碰撞失败率均低于2.3%。

title: Agreeing on the Answer but Not the Reason: Measurement Limits of LLM Reasoning Failure Taxonomies
title_zh: LLM推理失败分类的测量局限性：结论一致但原因不一
abstract: Failure taxonomies for LLM reasoning are increasingly reported as measurements: papers state what fraction of a model's errors fall into named categories, then compare those fractions across models. We show that for one such category the reported fraction is largely a property of the measurement procedure. We defined Compositional Collapse (a model notices a required sub-part of a problem, then drops or misapplies it) and measured it across twelve models and eleven languages on a public multilingual math benchmark (2,316 graded records). First, 50.1% of failures carry evidence for more than one category, so the reported plurality depends on the order in which the classifier tests them: reversing two tests moves it in eleven of twelve models, and across all six orderings Collapse's share spans 26.4% to 76.4%. Second, agreement collapses for the category but not for the task. Native speakers of all eleven languages judged 179 transcripts, agreeing with our inspector at kappa = 0.932 on answer correctness but only kappa = 0.093 on Collapse. A second native speaker per language re-rated 142 items; on 121 determinate pairs the two humans agree with each other at kappa = 0.659, while each agrees with the inspector at kappa <= 0.094. Re-running the same inspector model with the human instructions verbatim raises kappa against Human 2 from 0.147 to 0.636, so the gap is largely attributable to the prompt, not the model. Third, the inspector labels Collapse 1.81 times as often as native speakers, but only 1.17 times once a defective benchmark item (a deleted clause in the Bengali and Chinese translations) is excluded. We recommend four cheap checks before comparing failure-mode rates across models: report label co-occurrence, permute the tie-break, validate on a shared independent sample, and audit systematic disagreements.
summary_zh: 问题：LLM推理错误分类常被量化比较，但分类占比可能受测量过程影响。方法：定义“组合坍塌”错误并在12模型11语言上测量。结论：超半数失败属多类别，分类占比严重依赖分类器测试顺序。
问题：人类与自动检测器对“组合坍塌”类别的一致性低。方法：让11种语言的母语者评判转录文本。结论：对答案正确性一致性极高，但对“组合坍塌”类别一致性极低，差异主要归因于提示词而非模型。
问题：检测器对“组合坍塌”的标注频率远高于人类。方法：排除基准测试中有缺陷的翻译项并重新计算。结论：标注频率差异大幅缩小，表明数据缺陷也影响测量结果。
问题：跨模型比较失败模式率缺乏规范。方法：总结上述测量局限性。结论：建议比较前进行四项低成本检查：报告标签共现、排列打破平局顺序、共享验证及排查缺陷项。
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at IEEE CogMI 2026 (regular paper)

title: Which Successes Make Good References? Action-Sequence Alignment for Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: 多轮在线策略蒸馏中基于动作序列对齐的成功参考选择
abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-inference distribution mismatch by supervising a student on its own trajectories. For multi-turn tool-use agents, conditioning the teacher on a validated same-task successful trajectory as a reference can provide useful hindsight, but different successes may reach incompatible interaction states and offer misleading supervision. We cast successful-reference selection as a free-target optimal transport problem, which reduces to assigning each failed trajectory its most compatible successful reference. Because latent state paths are hidden, we use action-sequence alignment as an observable proxy for compatibility and instantiate it with longest common subsequence (LCS), which identifies a shared ordered backbone of actions while allowing recoverable detours. This perspective makes trajectory compatibility the central criterion for reference selection in multi-turn OPD. Experiments on ALFWorld and the airline domain of $τ^3$-bench show that LCS is the only evaluated reference selector to improve over reference-free OPD on both ALFWorld overall scores and all three airline metrics. Without further optimization, the airline-trained models also transfer to the retail domain, where LCS improves all three metrics.
summary_zh: 多轮工具使用智能体的在线策略蒸馏中，不同成功轨迹可能存在状态不兼容，导致误导性监督。
将成功参考选择建模为最优传输问题，利用最长公共子序列（LCS）作为动作序列对齐的代理来衡量轨迹兼容性。
实验表明，LCS是唯一在ALFWorld和τ³-bench航空域均优于无参考OPD的参考选择器，且零样本迁移至零售域仍有效。

title: ASPIRE: An Agentic System-Identification Platform for Iterative Reasoning and Exploration
title_zh: ASPIRE：用于迭代推理与探索的智能体系统辨识平台
abstract: System identification requires expert decisions on the identification method, incorporation of prior physical knowledge, and model validation. We propose ASPIRE, a framework for nonlinear system identification in which a large language model agent selects and executes the identification method. ASPIRE constructs closed-form, nonlinear static or dynamic models from measured data, optionally supplemented by a system description, the intended use of the model, and physical requirements expressed formally or in natural language. Each model includes its parameters, an estimation record, an interpretation of its terms, and an error evaluated on test data inaccessible to the agent. Formal physical requirements are verified independently. ASPIRE operates autonomously or interactively, allowing the agent to ask questions and the user to request further analyses and identification rounds. We evaluate ASPIRE on three measured systems: a mobile robot, a rotational system with dry friction, and a laboratory fermenter. Each system is tested with and without a description, in five runs per task. All 30 runs delivered valid models, at a cost of 0.96 to 3.38 US dollars per run. An assessment by the authors found that, for the 30 models recommended by the agent, one per run, the interpretation of the model and the documentation of its structure selection and parameter estimation fully satisfied 132 of 150 assessed items and partly satisfied 18. The most frequent discrepancy, found in nine models, concerned inaccurate or unsupported claims about model structure selection.
summary_zh: 非线性系统辨识依赖专家决策，本文提出ASPIRE框架，让LLM agent选择并执行辨识方法，实现自主或交互式建模。
ASPIRE从测量数据及物理约束中构建非线性模型，输出参数、估计记录、项解释及测试误差，并独立验证物理要求。
在三个实测系统评估中，30次运行均产出有效模型且成本极低，模型解释与文档在150项评估中132项完全满足。

title: Catch It Where It Happens: Real Time Error Correction During LLM Reasoning
title_zh: LLM推理过程中的实时错误纠正
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trusted with mathematical, scientific and engineering work, yet their mistakes are often confidently written and hard to spot. A single wrong step tends to propagate, making the model waste inference tokens following a false premise. Existing safeguards either check only the final answer and restart from scratch, or rely on a verifier LLM that competes for GPU capacity and slows down response time. We propose online, deterministic verification: many kinds of reasoning steps can be validated by code, so a step can be verified in real time, as it is written, without any model call or GPU use. Whenever a check fails, we point out the mistake and let the model continue from the same spot. We demonstrate this approach on symbolic mathematics, where derivations already contain explicit expressions that a computer algebra system can check in milliseconds. Tested on the ASyMoB benchmark with three open-weights models, our online validation improves accuracy by 1.4-5.6 percentage points, corresponding to a 1.8-14.9% net reduction in incorrect answers, while increasing token usage by only 6-7%. Because the verifier is independent of the model, the approach complements progress in LLMs rather than competing with it: every new model can benefit immediately, and the benefit grows as deterministic checkers extend to more kinds of reasoning steps.
summary_zh: LLM推理的单步错误易传播且难察觉，现有验证方法仅查终态或依赖额外LLM，开销大且慢。
提出在线确定性验证方法，利用代码实时校验推理步骤，无需调用LLM或占用GPU，失败时原地纠正。
在符号数学基准测试中，该方法提升准确率1.4-5.6个百分点，错误率降低1.8-14.9%，且仅增加6-7%的token开销。

title: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
title_zh: 面向智能体视觉推理的多教师同策略蒸馏框架Reframe
abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.
summary_zh: 视觉智能体易忽略工具返回的观测，且动作接地差导致后续蒸馏缺乏证据。
提出Reframe框架，将观测状态而非仅输出分布作为对齐目标，分两阶段训练。
实验表明Reframe优于Mix-RL和 vanilla MOPD，且无需任务特定的SFT冷启动。

title: Control Barrier Functions for Counting Tasks in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 多智能体系统计数任务的控制障碍函数方法
abstract: Multi-agent systems increasingly operate in dynamic environments and execute complex tasks that require coordination, posing significant computational challenges. Counting tasks, which require a minimum number of agents to satisfy a given condition, arise naturally in such systems. Examples include surveillance tasks, where at least m drones must continuously monitor a critical area, and emergency-response tasks, where at least m robots must converge to an incident location. The identities of the agents assigned to these tasks may change dynamically depending on their states, input bounds, and individual objectives. In this work, we propose a control barrier function (CBF)-based framework for enforcing counting invariance and counting convergence tasks, without explicitly assigning agents or enumerating all possible subteams. We develop a recursion-based method for constructing differentiable CBFs for counting tasks. The resulting CBF constraints are incorporated into quadratic programs, enabling online controller synthesis. Numerical experiments demonstrate scalability to large multi-agent systems, while a multi-drone emergency-response case study illustrates the satisfaction of counting tasks.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统的计数任务需保证最少智能体满足条件，显式分配计算量大且难以适应动态变化。
提出基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的框架，通过递归方法构建可微CBF，避免显式分配或枚举子团队。
将CBF约束融入二次规划实现在线控制器综合，实验验证了该方法的大规模可扩展性与任务有效性。
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures; This paper has been submitted to the European Control Conference 2027

title: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: WorkflowArena：LLM多智能体系统的可执行工作流编排基准
abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.
summary_zh: 现有基准仅评估端到端任务或预设结构下的协调，缺乏对LLM多智能体系统运行时工作流编排能力的直接衡量。
提出WorkflowArena基准，包含8个领域145项长程任务，通过隐藏验证器评估交付物质量，并记录智能体委派以联合评估工作组织。
实验表明不同模型呈现相异委派策略，且由强模型编写的工作流可显著提升弱执行器表现，证实工作流编排是任务性能的可测决定因素。

title: Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games
title_zh: 基于评估侧部分可观测博弈缓解智能体欺骗
abstract: As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful. We attribute this failure to evaluation-side partial observability, where models are evaluated mainly from final outcome, without checking the faithfulness of underlying reasoning, tool use, and environmental effects. Prior mitigations address this partial observability by predefined evaluator latent belief space or one-shot monitoring, which do not extend to free-form language space and vulnerable to stronger deceptions that evade simple monitoring. In this work, we formulate deception mitigation as an Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game (e-PoG), a max-min framework in which an agent maximizes reward, a monitor minimizes the agent's payoff by exposing deception from the full interaction trajectory, and a fixed verifier validates the monitor's claims and converts them into penalties. We define the solution concept as a Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium (SPOE) between agent and monitor, and prove its existence in finite games. With a perfect verifier, every SPOE is faithful; with an imperfect verifier, the guarantee persists if verifier errors do not reverse the ranking of monitor actions. To achieve faithful SPOE, we derive a two-timescale policy gradient algorithm and enhance the pipeline empirically with NLI verification and deterministic checks. Experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B on Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop show that e-PoG mitigates multiple emergent deception modes, outperforming the strongest baselines by 26.0% in deception mitigation and by up to 39.8% in task success. These gains persist under weak-to-strong supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent.
summary_zh: LLM智能体因评估仅看结果而忽略推理过程，易产生欺骗行为，现有监控方法难以应对自由文本和强欺骗。
将缓解欺骗建模为评估侧部分可观测扩展式博弈，引入监控者揭露欺骗与验证者施加惩罚，证明子博弈完美监督均衡存在且可保证诚实。
提出双时间尺度策略梯度算法并融合NLI验证，实验表明该方法缓解多种欺骗模式，欺骗缓解与任务成功率均显著优于基线。

title: Programming Prescience: Issues in Human Construction of Forecasting Bots
title_zh: 构建预测机器人：人类面临的挑战与问题
abstract: AI models' growing capacity for complex reasoning has made them attractive tools for forecasting, or the systematic prediction of the future based on past and present data. However, should AI forecasting systems be adopted, human builders will shoulder the work of building and evaluating them. In this paper, we explore what this work looks like with a qualitative interview study with 15 builders of forecasting bots, sampled from among successful participants in a recent AI forecasting competition. Our analysis surfaces the challenges around (1) tuning a bot to acquire factual research, (2) implementing coherent reasoning, and (3) understanding how well one's bot actually does. During their work, builders frequently introduced complexity that did not pay off, and tested in ways that were opportunistic and piecemeal. Our detailed account of their challenges helps clarify what problems should be targeted in upcoming innovations in process, tools, and human-AI teaming for forecasting.
summary_zh: AI预测系统日益普及，但人类构建与评估工作负担加重，需明确该过程的具体挑战。
通过对15位预测机器人构建者访谈，发现获取事实研究、实现连贯推理及评估性能三大挑战。
构建者常引入无效复杂性且测试零散，该结论为未来预测工具与人机协作创新指明方向。

title: Coding Agents in KVM: Practical Containment and User Control with Limited Resources
title_zh: KVM中的编码代理：有限资源下的实际隔离与用户控制
abstract: Coding agents often need broad authority for productive development work, but granting that authority can expose users' data and infrastructure. Off-the-shelf cloud workspaces can help contain agent activity, but reliance on provider-specific platforms can lead to vendor lock-in and reduced user control. Researchers and engineers must therefore balance agent autonomy, enforced containment, and user control within available financial, computational, and human resources. We analyze these trade-offs and present KVM-Agent, an open-source implementation that automates most setup and provisioning steps. It gives agents broad authority inside replaceable Ubuntu VMs while keeping host administration outside those VMs and supporting multiple coding-agent applications, model services, and remote job delegation. The approach retains familiar workflows and user choice at the cost of VM resources, maintenance, and residual risks from secrets accessible inside the VMs and permitted network access.
summary_zh: 编码代理需广泛权限但易威胁数据安全，云工作台易致供应商锁定，需平衡代理自主性、隔离与控制。
提出KVM-Agent开源实现，自动化配置步骤，在可替换Ubuntu VM内赋权代理，同时将宿主管理置于VM外。
该方案支持多代理应用与模型服务，保留用户习惯与选择权，代价是VM资源开销、维护及内部密钥与网络风险。

title: Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference
title_zh: 免反演的高维反事实推断
abstract: Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and ADNI, we benchmark our approach using two measures: namely, effectiveness and identity preservation. While effectiveness is a measure of how faithfully the counterfactual attribute is rendered, identity preservation measures whether the same unit (image) is being rendered, both of which are crucial for high-dimensional counterfactual inference. We present the tradeoffs of using inversion-based and inversion-free approaches in our work.
summary_zh: 高维节点（如图像）的反事实推断比标量1-D情形更具挑战，传统方法需从事实图像反演恢复潜状态。
本文探讨反演步骤的必要性，引入图像编辑领域的免反演方法来计算高维反事实结果。
在CelebA和ADNI数据集上的实验表明，免反演与基于反演的方法在有效性与身份保持上存在权衡。

title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
title_zh: 通过同策略蒸馏恢复LLM Agent遗忘能力的Agentic-OPD
abstract: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.
summary_zh: RL训练LLM Agent时仅保留最佳验证检查点，导致其遗忘早期检查点已解决的问题，丢弃的检查点构成了零额外成本的教师池。
提出Agentic-OPD框架，利用学生能力缺口指导教师选择与监督过滤：HCN策略按覆盖率动态选教师，LAD模块将知识迁移限制在教师更优的失败轨迹上。
在5个Agent领域和24个基准上，Agentic-OPD较初始检查点提升达7.4分，4B模型在深度搜索上超越GPT-5.6等前沿模型。
comment: 10 pages of main text, 24 pages total including references and appendix

title: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning
title_zh: 基于LLM的通用搜索器：面向开放世界AutoML
abstract: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.
summary_zh: 现有AutoML框架局限于特定领域且孤立优化各配置，本文提出无需微调的LLM通用AutoML框架以联合优化。
提出NCode编码方案将配置转为离散序列，把优化重构为排序任务，仅用单域数据训练即实现跨任务与跨模态泛化。
结合强化学习引入思维链推理，揭示搜索器从早期多样性探索到后期锚点利用的策略转变，提升可解释性。

title: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
title_zh: 基于鲁棒Token级重加权的偏好优化
abstract: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT
summary_zh: 偏好优化对齐LLM易受标注噪声影响，现有序列级方法忽略了拒绝样本中的有效Token和偏好样本中的错误Token。
提出PORT框架，利用Token对数概率的经验累积分布函数进行重加权，作为梯度范数惩罚的高效前向传播代理。
理论证明PORT通过最小化偏差上界减少噪声标签的梯度偏差，实验表明其鲁棒性一致优于序列级基线。

title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
title_zh: Sage-Taiyi：面向科学发现的元认知架构
abstract: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.
summary_zh: 【问题→方法→结论】科学发现需动态调整研究目标与方法，为此提出Sage-Taiyi元认知架构，通过显式监控与控制修正认知并适配推理，实现科学探索的自主调节。
【问题→方法→结论】为评估AI科学构思能力，构建含10学科265任务的Taiyi-Bench，Sage-Taiyi在8项指标上均排名第一，整体得分54.0超越最强基线。
【问题→方法→结论】为验证其实用性，开展5项专家合作，在化学反应条件优化中成功将钴催化羰基化产率提升至84%，证实该架构能推进至实验验证阶段。

title: A Hoare Logic for Continuous-Time Stochastic Processes
title_zh: 连续时间随机过程的霍尔逻辑
abstract: Programming language researchers have developed a wide array of tools to reason about probabilistic programs, but it remains unclear how to apply these proof techniques to continuous-time stochastic processes. To bridge this gap, we propose a verification method for properties of continuous-time stochastic processes by reasoning about them as standard programs. To demonstrate our approach, we define a continuous semantics for a probabilistic imperative language $\mathrm{pWhile}^{\mathrm{dt}}$ by taking the Kuratowski limit of the standard semantics, which collects limit points of the standard program semantics as the time-step approaches zero. Then, we present a Hoare-style logic that uses loop invariants and decreasing functions to verify properties of continuous programs. To establish soundness, we identify a broad class of assertions that are preserved from the standard semantics to the continuous semantics. To demonstrate our approach, we verify properties of ten continuous-time stochastic processes modeled in $\mathrm{pWhile}^{\mathrm{dt}}$, including variants of Brownian motion and a stochastic hybrid system.
summary_zh: 现有概率程序验证工具难以直接用于连续时间随机过程，本文提出将其作为标准程序推理的验证方法。
定义pWhile^dt的连续语义（取标准语义的Kuratowski极限），并提出基于循环不变式与递减函数的霍尔逻辑。
证明一类广泛断言从标准到连续语义的保持性以保证可靠性，并成功验证10个连续时间随机过程实例。

title: DeepChronos: Temporal Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Multi-Step Attack Detection
title_zh: DeepChronos：面向多步攻击检测的时序神经符号推理
abstract: Modern cyber threats commonly unfold as multi-step attacks comprising temporally and causally related phases. Current defenses commonly follow a detect first and correlate later paradigm. Intrusion detection systems classify events independently, while downstream systems reconstruct attack progression from the resulting alerts or audit records. In this context, learning-based detectors learn attack-step dependencies implicitly as statistical regularities in the data and cannot guarantee that their predictions follow the real attack progression. Conversely, correlation systems represent attack relationships explicitly, but apply this knowledge only after the underlying attack observations have been detected. We present DEEPCHRONOS, a neuro-symbolic network intrusion detection system that shifts the paradigm from detect first and correlate later to detection through logical progression. DEEPCHRONOS combines learned flow-level evidence with explicit attack-phase rules, temporal prerequisites, and previously inferred phases, allowing the evolving attack history to inform and constrain each detection decision. Evaluations on DARPA 2000 and AIT-LDS V2 show that DEEPCHRONOS improves macro F1 over purely neural baselines by up to 11.3%, eliminates causal violations under strict temporal constraints, and maintains millisecond-scale inference latency. These results demonstrate that integrating explicit attack progression knowledge into detection produces more accurate and temporally coherent multi-step attack predictions.
summary_zh: 现有检测与关联分离的范式无法保证预测符合真实攻击时序与因果逻辑。
提出DEEPCHRONOS，融合流级证据与显式攻击规则及历史，以逻辑推演指导检测。
该方法提升宏观F1达11.3%，消除因果违规，且保持毫秒级推理延迟。

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
title_zh: 多轮临床Agent的安全强化学习：密集奖励优于结果奖励
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.
summary_zh: 多轮临床Agent的强化学习效果尚不明确，本文构建含隐状态和查询成本的三个受控临床环境进行实证研究。
仅用结果奖励的RL常导致过早提交、单问题崩溃及高风险案例失败，而赋予降低不确定性的步骤密集奖励可提升泛化与中危支持。
分离探索与利用可提升高风险支持但增加低危查询，过程奖励强度依赖任务，且RL无法可靠修复监督数据的罕见偏差。

title: Multi-Agent Screening: What Agreement and Acceptance Cannot Tell You
title_zh: 多智能体筛选：一致性与接受度无法揭示的信息
abstract: When AI agents screen items for a costly human assessor, as in agentic search, e-discovery and AI reviewing of papers, only what they pass gets judged. We show what each kind of evidence can establish about their errors, even with unlimited data. Agreement shows that agents concur, not that they are right, however many there are. Acceptance by the assessor gives precision but only a lower bound on recall. Knowing which agents found which relevant items gives an upper bound on recall if agents' finds are not negatively correlated, and caps what one more agent can add if agents are interchangeable. Without assumptions about the agents, recall can be pinned down only by judging items they did not pass: a random sample of these estimates how many relevant items were missed, to any chosen accuracy, and the sample needed does not grow with the number of agents.
summary_zh: 多智能体筛选中，仅凭智能体间的一致性无法证明其正确，评估者的接受度也只能提供召回率的下界。
若智能体发现的相关项非负相关，其交集可提供召回率上界，并限制新增智能体的边际贡献。
无先验假设下，仅能通过评估被筛除项来精确确定召回率，随机抽样估计遗漏量的成本不随智能体数量增加。

title: Hierarchical Nonlinear Control for Swarm Encirclement Around a Moving Target UAV
title_zh: 基于分层非线性控制的无人机集群动态目标围捕
abstract: This paper presents a hierarchical inner-outer loop nonlinear control strategy using a geometric Lyapunov-based framework for the cooperative encirclement of a target by multi-ple unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in three-dimensional space. The encirclement problem is formulated on a two-sphere with arbitrary radius and center, denoted Gamma-2, by projecting agent positions from R3 onto a spherical manifold centered at the target, being the unit two-sphere at the origin S2 used for intermediate calculations. Desired encirclement configurations are generated via a point separation method on Gamma-2, while stable convergence from R3 to these points is guaranteed using a Lyapunov-based reduced-attitude control law inspired by geometric control on the two-sphere. Formal stability results are derived using Lyapunov analysis and the framework is validated in simulation using a nonlinear quadrotor model and controller. Results demonstrate stable encirclement and highlight the suitability of the proposed approach for three-dimensional multi-agent aerial systems.
summary_zh: 针对多无人机在三维空间协同围捕移动目标的问题，提出基于几何李雅普诺夫框架的分层内外环非线性控制策略。
将围捕问题建模于二维球面流形，通过点分离法生成期望构型，并基于降姿态控制律保证智能体稳定收敛至目标点。
李雅普诺夫分析证明了系统稳定性，非线性四旋翼模型仿真验证了该方法能有效实现稳定围捕，适用于三维多智能体系统。
comment: Pre-print. Accepted at the 17th APCA International Conference on Automatic Control and Soft Computing (CONTROLO 2026); 6 pages, 6 figures

title: Surrendering and Reclaiming Judgment: How Software Engineering Students Experience AI Reliance
title_zh: 软件工程学生如何经历对AI的依赖与判断力重夺
abstract: Software architecture is one of the skills novice developers must master to succeed in industry, and as AI disrupts software development, it is also transforming how students learn architecture. Existing work on how students and novices work with AI has mostly focused on small programming exercises or on students' perceptions of AI, so little is known about how students experience AI as they learn software architecture in larger team projects. We report on an exploratory case study of 43 senior software engineering students who used AI throughout a semester-long, team-based software architecture project. We combined surveys with focus groups and analyzed the focus group transcripts and the open survey responses through Braun and Clarke's reflexive thematic analysis. We constructed two themes. The first, Surrendering Judgment to AI, traces how participants' reliance on AI deepened as they used it to architect and implement their systems, until they surrendered their judgment and became stuck in a codebase they had created but could not understand, which made them rely on AI even more. Participants described feeling ashamed, frustrated, and emotionally disconnected from their work, a toll that, in our reading, left them with even less reason to break their reliance. The second, Applying Human Judgment, centers on participants who kept or reclaimed their judgment: the knowledge and experience it rested on, and the strategies they used to apply it. Participants' accounts suggest that relaxed deadlines and a lecture and lab on working with AI gave them room to acquire knowledge and reclaim judgment. Given the expectations placed on junior developers and the widespread adoption of AI, we believe these first-hand accounts can help software engineering education and industry adopt AI in ways that preserve novice developers' judgment, ownership, and motivation.
summary_zh: 现有研究多关注小规模编程，缺乏学生在大型团队项目中学习软件架构时依赖AI的经验。
对43名学生进行案例研究，发现过度依赖AI会导致学生放弃判断力，陷入无法理解的代码库，加剧依赖并产生负面情绪。
保留或重夺判断力的学生依靠自身知识与策略，宽松期限及AI使用指导为他们提供了重夺判断力的空间。

title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
title_zh: TrialDesignBench：基于临床知识的大语言模型I期试验设计基准
abstract: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.
summary_zh: 临床试验统计设计缺乏AI辅助，且FDA新规使旧设计失效，亟需新评估基准。
提出TrialDesignBench基准，包含617个肿瘤试验及符合FDA新规的专家验证参考设计。
评估5个前沿LLM均未达参考标准，归因分析揭示补充隐含决定因素和结构化推理可显著提升准确率。
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Presented as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS). Code and data: https://github.com/hanktang-research/TrialDesignBench

title: FAROS: Forecast-Aware Risk-Informed Online Reinforcement Learning for Proactive O-RAN Slicing
title_zh: 面向主动O-RAN切片的预测感知风险在线强化学习框架FAROS
abstract: Proactive Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) slicing requires decisions before an approaching quality-of-service (QoS) loss becomes difficult to reverse. We present FAROS, a Forecast-Aware Risk-Informed O-RAN Slicing framework that combines an eight-step QoS forecast, training-only PCMCI+-supported temporal risk, Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) under centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE), symbolic feasibility constraints, and reliability-aware Top-K arbitration. MAPPO supplies the actor proposal, while A5v2 checks admissibility and one-step utility before execution. Evaluation uses ten validation-selected frozen checkpoints, 500 matched start indices per seed under the risky-start protocol, and 150,000 agent-level decisions. FAROS obtains mean reward 0.2778 and ten-step recovery 90.56% across ten seeds. A fixed model-matched diagnostic rule reaches reward 0.3015 and recovery 97.57% under the same transition-reward contract, so we make no superiority claim over direct threshold logic. A same-actor M4 shield control also reaches zero risky-state prohibited actions. In the M5 trace, A5v2 changes 22.61% of actor proposals and reduces the predicate-defined prohibited-action rate from 16.79% at proposal time to zero at execution; this property is enforced by the arbiter rather than learned by MAPPO. Independent ns-3 experiments test the six-action interface at packet level and remain separate from end-to-end FAROS claims.
summary_zh: 主动O-RAN切片需提前决策以避免QoS损失不可逆，提出FAROS框架解决此问题。
结合QoS预测、时序风险评估与MAPPO算法，辅以符号可行性约束与可靠性感知仲裁器，确保动作合规。
实验表明FAROS实现90.56%的十步恢复率，仲裁器将违规动作率降至零，该安全属性由仲裁器强制保证。
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management (TNSM)

title: Beyond Sunny Skies: Using Large Language Models to Predict Urban Traffic in Adverse Weather
title_zh: 基于大语言模型的恶劣天气城市交通预测
abstract: Urban traffic flow prediction is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems, yet accurate forecasting under adverse weather conditions remains a significant challenge. Existing data-driven models, while effective for routine patterns, often struggle with the sparse data and complex non-linear shifts associated with rare meteorological events. These methods typically treat environmental contexts as shallow numerical features, failing to capture the underlying semantic reasoning-why and how specific adverse conditions alter mobility behaviors across regions with different functional compositions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-STG, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-derived semantic priors with graph-based spatiotemporal learning. Multi-STG introduces an LLM-empowered semantic enhancement module that transforms comprehensive context descriptions such as weather, POIs, and holidays into high-level semantic embeddings, effectively providing a knowledge-driven complement to data scarcity. Furthermore, we design a multimodal attentional fusion mechanism to dynamically weigh heterogeneous inputs and a semantic-enhanced prediction head with gated residual calibration to robustly adjust forecasts based on semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-city private car datasets demonstrate that Multi-STG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MAE by 11.82\% on average relative to the strongest baseline across three cities, while maintaining stable performance under sparse and non-stationary conditions.
summary_zh: 恶劣天气下交通数据稀疏且呈复杂非线性，现有模型仅将环境作浅层数值特征，难以捕捉语义推理。
提出Multi-STG框架，用LLM将天气等上下文转为语义嵌入，弥补数据稀缺，并设计多模态注意力融合与门控残差预测头。
在多城市数据集上，Multi-STG平均MAE较最强基线降低11.82%，在稀疏非平稳条件下性能稳定。

title: Creative Intent as an Evolving Shared State: Supporting Cross-Stage Human-AI Video Co-Creation
title_zh: 创意意图作为演进的共享状态：支持跨阶段人机视频共创
abstract: As generative AI becomes increasingly involved in video creation, creators face challenges in expanding, translating, and negotiating creative intent across stages. We therefore view creative intent as an evolving shared state throughout human-AI co-creation. A multi-stage design was employed: semi-structured interviews with 12 creators informed 3 design goals, followed by expert co-design and the development of VideoMaker. VideoMaker organizes creation into a six-stage workflow that progressively translates creative intent. At key stages, creators negotiate with AI through the Seed Panel, explicitly confirming, revising, and updating intent. A shared AI Agent, supported by the Multi-style Script Library and Cinematic Language Knowledge Base, enables differentiated expansion of initial intent and faithful translation. A within-subjects study with 30 participants showed that VideoMaker effectively supported the expansion and cross-stage translation of creative intent, with stronger intent preservation, while negotiated boundaries between creator-confirmed intent and AI initiative remained difficult to sustain.
summary_zh: 视频创作者在跨阶段扩展、转化和协商创意意图时面临挑战，需将创意意图视为人机共创中演进的共享状态。
基于访谈提出设计目标并开发VideoMaker系统，通过六阶段工作流渐进转化意图，并设Seed Panel供人机协商确认。
系统借助共享AI Agent等实现意图的差异化扩展与忠实转化；实验表明其能有效支持意图跨阶段转化与保持，但人机协商边界仍难维持。

title: Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 评估乳腺X光视觉语言模型的跨信号一致性
abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.
summary_zh: 现有VLM评估多仅看准确率，未检验其答案、置信度与解释间的一致性，难以判断AI输出的可信度。
在两个乳腺数据集上，通过控制扰动问题和选项顺序及图像，评估四种VLM在乳腺密度和BI-RADS分类上的一致性。
发现VLM置信度不随图像改变而降低，选项乱序会改变答案，且存在推理与最终答案矛盾的情况。

title: GHiML: VLM-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning with Applications to Benthic Imagery
title_zh: 基于VLM引导的层次多标签学习及其在底栖影像中的应用
abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) encode substantial expert knowledge within their weights, yet their direct application to specialised classification domains such as benthic imagery remains limited. Meanwhile, vision transformers trained on these tasks rely predominantly on low-level visual latents (colours, textures, and shapes) that lack the higher-level reasoning humans employ for identification. We propose Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label (GHiML) learning, a pipeline that extracts conceptual latent variables from a VLM conditioned on training data, generates sample-relevant captions grounded in those variables, and fuses the resulting textual embeddings with image embeddings via cross-attention and a per-node gated router. We also introduce the inverted HML score ($d_{\mathrm{inv}}$), a similarity score that evaluates hierarchical multi-label predictions through graph traversal distance and a cardinality penalty, providing an interpretable alternative to existing measures, which are insensitive to realistic degradations in sparse, deep hierarchies. Experiments on BenthicNet, FathomNet and iNaturalist show that the router improves macro $F_1$ over the vision-only baseline by up to 6.7 pp and $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ by up to 21.1 pp on in-domain benthic data, with gains persisting under distribution shift. Ablations locate the contribution of the text itself: on the multi-label biotic hierarchies, removing the per-sample text signal degrades $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ while leaving macro $F_1$ unchanged, consistent with text acting through prediction cardinality rather than node discrimination, whereas iNaturalist, whose annotations are single-label, loses 18.7% of macro $F_1$. Our results support the hypothesis that VLMs contain exploitable specialised knowledge that, when appropriately elicited, can augment classification in domains where direct visual learning is insufficient.
summary_zh: 现有视觉模型缺乏高层推理能力，提出GHiML框架，利用VLM提取概念变量生成描述并融合图文特征，提升分类性能。
现有评估指标对深层稀疏层级不敏感，提出反转HML分数，通过图遍历距离与基数惩罚评估预测，提供可解释的替代方案。
实验表明GHiML在底栖数据上显著提升F1和反转HML分数，且分布偏移下增益稳定，证实VLM蕴含可利用的专业知识。

title: SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery
title_zh: SciMARS：面向闭环科学发现的多智能体递归自改进框架
abstract: We propose SciMARS, a framework for recursive task-local adaptation of multi-agent harnesses in closed-loop scientific discovery. Multi-agent systems coordinate analysis, experimental design, and verification as scientific evidence evolves. However, two problems limit their effectiveness: (i) without shared memory, agents lose observations and repeat work; (ii) fixed role procedures, handoffs, and memory policies perpetuate mistakes despite retained evidence. We address these problems with a shared evidence graph and separate component editors. SciMARS adapts roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory adds a third editor for how agents record, retrieve, and receive evidence. Candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next harness. We evaluate scientific discovery through experimental-data replay and a digital twin. SciMARS + Memory resolves 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, compared with 8/18 and 1/18 for the base multi-agent team. On ScienceAgentBench and AppWorld, it solves 14/38 and 11/20 tasks, compared with 11/38 and 5/20 for the base team. These results support combining shared memory with harness adaptation across scientific and interactive tasks.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统在闭环科学发现中，因缺乏共享记忆导致重复工作，且固定角色与策略会延续错误。
提出SciMARS框架，引入共享证据图与组件编辑器，递归调整智能体角色、协调及记忆策略。
实验表明，结合共享记忆与系统适配，SciMARS在多项科学及交互任务基准上显著优于基线团队。

title: Teamknitt: Configuring, Observing and Intervening in LLM-Agent Teams through the Lens of Dynamical-Systems and Human-Team Theory
title_zh: Teamknitt：基于动力学与人类团队理论的LLM-Agent团队框架
abstract: Most frameworks for teams of large language model (LLM) agents fix the team's shape inside the software: who talks to whom, how much is passed along, and what a human can do once a run has started. Human-team research has long asked those questions: where team phenomena live (in members or in their interaction), how team-level properties arise, and what separates what a team does from how a team is. I propose using that theory as the organizing lens for configuring, observing and intervening in LLM-agent teams, without assuming its findings transfer. I introduce teamknitt, a framework and open reference implementation in which a user configures a team of 1-16 AI agents for task completion, solution generation, achieving a goal or a research mission; selects one of fourteen deterministic routing topologies or a custom directed graph; chooses a sharing profile that limits what may travel along permitted routes; and binds sources, representations, work dependencies, handoffs and an expertise directory. The recorded process can be observed through non-system views (member reports and behavior) and system views (distributed problem-solving, differentiated transactive memory, interactive coordination, team dynamics). Interventions are explicit and human-led: reviewed reconfiguration between runs, planned disturbances, and private feedback, pause, resume or stop applied at dependency-wave boundaries, with "queued", "applied", "assembled", "understood" and "improved" kept as separate claims. Emergent states such as trust and shared understanding are declared unmeasured. This is an idea and system-description paper with falsifiable hypotheses on topology, information flow and intervention timing, including whether the fractal scaling of communication output between members, and between members on different models, relates to task and team performance. No comparative result is reported.
summary_zh: 现有LLM-Agent团队框架固化通信与交互，缺乏对团队整体属性及人机干预的灵活支持。
提出Teamknitt框架，结合人类团队理论，支持配置1-16个Agent的路由拓扑、信息共享及工作依赖。
系统支持显式人工干预与多视角观察，提出关于拓扑与信息流的可证伪假设，并声明信任等涌现态不可测。
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Reference implementation v0.9.0: https://github.com/JeranRolevs/teamknitt

title: Is AMOC collapse too unstable in climate models?
title_zh: 气候模型中的AMOC崩溃是否过于不稳定？
abstract: It has been a long-held paradigm that the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation in coupled climate models is too stable, underestimating the possibility of a collapse. A recent analysis of extended simulations to year 2300 in the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project, CMIP6, demonstrated a partial AMOC collapse where the deep circulation completely vanishes. This collapse was simulated by at least one model in all emission scenarios, and it occurred in every model forced by the highest emission scenario when extended to year 2300. Given the modelling community's previous emphasis on stability in climate models, in this perspective, we explore the alternate possible mechanisms by which the AMOC in CMIP6 might have become too unstable. This is motivated by the lack of evidence of downward trends in the AMOC in the observational records, and a subset of CMIP6 models displaying too high climate sensitivity and too strong sensitivity to aerosol removal, both of which could predispose them toward a spurious collapse. For these reasons, it is critical to evaluate the mechanisms by which CMIP6 models simulate AMOC collapse, to be able to develop programs further investigating the trustworthiness of simulated AMOC collapse scenarios.
summary_zh: 以往认为耦合气候模型低估了AMOC崩溃风险，但CMIP6延伸模拟显示最高排放下均发生部分崩溃。
观测记录缺乏AMOC下降趋势，且部分模型对气溶胶移除过于敏感，可能导致其模拟出虚假崩溃。
需评估CMIP6模型模拟AMOC崩溃的机制，以进一步验证模拟崩溃情景的可靠性。

title: Gravity Without Absolutes
title_zh: 无绝对时空的引力理论
abstract: By formulating his theory of universal gravitation in absolute space and time, Newton demonstrated the power of reductionism; it has been behind every major advance in physics since then. However, the lack of significant advances over the last half-century, together with unresolved problems in the dominant paradigms of physics and cosmology, suggest that holism may need to replace reductionism as the way forward. The ontological simplicity and historical significance of Newtonian gravity makes it the ideal theory for examining this possibility. Taking Newton's second law of motion to be the core of his theory, we show that its use within the reductionist framework of absolute space and time introduces an infinity of arbitrary solutions if used to describe $N$-body universes rather than subsystems within them. We show that Leibniz's principle of sufficient reason (PSR) eliminates the infinite arbitrariness and transforms the predicted nature of $N$-body universes; they are all shown to be unexpectedly interesting. An even greater change is enforced if one asks what principle could determine the number of particles in the universe. The PSR suggests it can only be infinite. We suggest that, in such a universe, correlation could replace causation while still giving the appearance that each state has been created by dynamical evolution from the past, whereas its actual explanation may lie entirely within the present state. While much work remains to develop these ideas into a viable theory, we are confident that it advances the case for holism.
summary_zh: 物理学半个世纪未获重大突破，还原论范式遇阻，需探索以整体论取代还原论的新路径。
在绝对时空的还原论框架下用牛顿第二定律描述N体宇宙会引入无限任意解，莱布尼茨的充足理由律可消除该任意性。
充足理由律要求宇宙粒子数无限，在此宇宙中关联可替代因果，为整体论提供了新理论支撑。
comment: 60 pages, 9 figures. Significantly expanded text of online talk by Julian Barbour for Time in Physics International Workshop, São Paulo, Brazil, 13/05/2025, available at the link https://www.youtube.com/@PrincipiaInstituteprograms

title: AuDiR: Diagnosing Audio Reasoning with Rule and Percept Interventions
title_zh: AuDiR：基于规则与感知干预的音频推理诊断
abstract: Answer accuracy alone does not distinguish failures in acoustic perception, rule knowledge, and rule application. AuDiR (Audio Diagnostic Reasoning) examines these distinctions through controlled input interventions. Each item contains an audio clip, a multiple-choice question, a task-general rule, and a textual description of the acoustic observations needed to answer. Three conditions progressively supply the rule and observations; a fourth removes the audio while retaining the question and rule. The first correct diagnostic condition assigns an operational response label, without identifying a unique internal cause. The current benchmark contains 201 items in 18 families drawn from 9 sources, with answer references documented separately from percept extraction. In a preliminary evaluation of Gemini-3.8-flash, accuracy is 29.3% without supplied information, 31.3% with the rule, and 98.5% with the observations also supplied. No-audio accuracy is 23.9%, with a confidence interval containing the 25.0% chance rate. A family-level knowledge probe associates incomplete rule recall with larger gains from rule provision. These results show the benefit of supplying acoustic observations as text, while incomplete validation, possible recognition shortcuts, and non-monotonic responses limit stronger failure-attribution claims.
summary_zh: 仅靠答案准确率无法区分音频感知、规则知识与应用的失败，提出AuDiR框架通过受控输入干预诊断音频推理。
AuDiR设计四种条件渐进提供规则与声学观察文本，首个正确条件分配操作响应标签，避免唯一内部归因。
对Gemini-3.8-flash的评估表明提供声学观察文本能大幅提升准确率，但验证不完整等因素限制了强归因声明。

title: Optimised Distillation for Nucleon Correlation Functions
title_zh: 核子关联函数的优化蒸馏方法
abstract: The calculation and analysis of nucleon correlation functions is essential for understanding the observed spectra and structure of these ubiquitous hadrons. Two challenges arise in their analysis: at early Euclidean times, they are dominated by excited state contributions and at later Euclidean times, the signal-to-noise ratio degrades exponentially. This leads to a common challenge in identifying a reasonable window on which to extract the ground state energy. By modulating the contribution of each Laplacian eigenmode to the correlator via distillation profiles, we build optimised operators which improve the overlap with the nucleon ground state. In these proceedings, we present our progress on constructing optimised distillation profiles for nucleons and their excited state suppression in two- and three-point correlation functions.
summary_zh: 核子关联函数分析面临早期受激发态主导、晚期信噪比指数衰减的挑战，难以确定提取基态能量的合理窗口。
通过蒸馏分布调制拉普拉斯本征模对关联函数的贡献，构建了优化算符以提升与核子基态的重叠。
构建了核子优化蒸馏分布，并在二点和三点关联函数中验证了其对激发态的有效抑制。
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, Contribution to the 43rd International Symposium on Lattice Field Theory (Lattice 2026)

title: Causal discovery from Bayesian symbolic regression
title_zh: 基于贝叶斯符号回归的因果发现
abstract: Causal discovery from observational data is central to scientific reasoning, yet established constraint-based and score-based methods often recover only a Markov equivalence class and provide no signal in bivariate or strongly autocorrelated regimes typical in some areas of science. Here, we recast causal discovery as a Bayesian symbolic regression problem. Given a set of candidate parents for each target variable, the Bayesian symbolic regression samples closed-form expressions from a posterior over symbolic models. The fraction of sampled expressions in which each candidate variable appears defines a posterior inclusion probability that we use as the causal score. This replaces pointwise model selection by an ensemble of plausible mechanisms. We evaluate the method on coupled nonlinear bivariate dynamics, on the CauseMe benchmark suite spanning linear, chaotic, nonlinear, higher-dimensional and high-noise settings, and on a four-variable biogeoscience structural causal model under Gaussian, heavy-tailed and mixed-noise regimes. Our approach is competitive with, and often outperforms, specialized causal discovery algorithms. Additionally, the method returns closed-form mechanisms leading to explicit causality and interpretability.
summary_zh: 传统因果发现方法常只能恢复等价类，且在双变量或强自相关场景下失效。
将因果发现重构为贝叶斯符号回归问题，用候选变量的后验包含概率作为因果得分，以模型集成替代点估计。
在多种非线性及高噪声基准测试中表现优于专用算法，且能返回显式因果机制，具备强可解释性。

title: The Gene Is Not the Gate: Conceptualizing the Semantic Genome of Quantum Software
title_zh: 量子软件的语义基因组：跨层语义责任与QGenome框架
abstract: Quantum software spans applications, program representations, compilers, runtimes, and hardware-facing control. Existing abstractions describe these artifacts and layers, but they do not capture the semantic responsibilities that must remain valid as a computation is transformed across the stack. This limits systematic reasoning about cross-layer correctness, evolution, and reuse. We present QGenome, a semantic foundation for quantum software genomics. We define a quantum software gene as a typed, reusable responsibility characterized by an explicit contract, execution context, concrete expressions, and supporting evidence. QGenome organizes genes across five software strata and ten responsibility families grouped into computational semantics, coordination, realization, and assurance. Typed genes compose into pathways and genomes through dependency, refinement, provenance, and phenotype relations, enabling responsibilities to be traced across alternative implementations and execution contexts. We illustrate the taxonomy using representative public artifacts across the quantum software stack and define principles for contextual validity, genome evolution, environmental adaptation, and capability expression. Rather than presenting a complete taxonomy or an automated extraction technique, QGenome establishes a falsifiable framework and a concrete research agenda for gene mining, lineage recovery, cross-layer regression testing and repair, and evidence-grounded quantum software agents.
summary_zh: 现有量子软件抽象无法捕获跨层转换中须保持的语义责任，限制了跨层正确性与复用的系统推理。
提出QGenome框架，将量子软件基因定义为带类型的可复用责任，按五层软件与十族责任进行组织。
基因可组合为路径与基因组以实现跨层责任追踪，为基因挖掘、跨层修复及量子软件agent提供研究议程。

title: Mechanisms of Zener diode and ohmic contact resulting from a heavily doped p-n junction: A novel explanation in terms of impurity-photovoltaic-effect resulting from infrared self-emission at room-temperature
title_zh: 重掺杂p-n结的齐纳二极管与欧姆接触机制：室温红外自发射杂质光伏效应新解
abstract: In textbooks, a quantum-mechanical tunneling mechanism based on electron-wavefunction is used to explain Zener diode as well as ohmic contact resulting from a heavily doped p-n junction. In this study, an attempt in particle description is made to explain these devices. Any object at room-temperature emits infrared (IR) photons. The process of heavy doping can cause many defects. The self-absorption of the IR emission could be achieved through sub-band-gap excitations due to defects, creating carriers. In a heavily doped p-n junction device, some of the IR-generated carriers diffuse into the junction which has a built-in field. The built-in field sweeps out the carriers, creating IR photocurrent. The reverse leakage current of the p-n junction is regarded as the IR photocurrent according to a precedent where impurity-photovoltaic-effect is used to explain circuit devices (arXiv:2510.18226). Heavy doping results in not only a great many IR-generated carriers but also an avalanche effect at low voltage, producing Zener breakdown. Additionally, the impurity-photovoltaic-effect can make a reasonable contribution to explaining the temperature dependence of Zener breakdown. If the doping is very heavy, the heavily doped p-n junction can be altered to create an ohmic contact, which can also be explained in terms of impurity-photovoltaic-effect. Not only quantum mechanics, but also this photovoltaic mechanism in particle description can explain the above devices. Considering the wave-particle duality, the combination of quantum-mechanical and photovoltaic mechanisms is suggested to explain these devices. Each mechanism plays a big or small role in the explanation.
summary_zh: 传统教材用量子隧穿解释重掺杂p-n结器件，本文提出基于粒子描述的杂质光伏效应新机制。
重掺杂产生缺陷，室温红外自发射经缺陷亚带隙激发产生载流子，被结区内建电场扫出形成光电流，以此解释反向漏电流与齐纳击穿。
该机制还能解释齐纳击穿的温度依赖性及极重掺杂下的欧姆接触，结合波粒二象性，建议量子隧穿与光伏机制共同解释此类器件。

title: Scalable Practical Synchronization of Heterogeneous Linear Systems
title_zh: 异构线性系统的可扩展实用同步
abstract: We study practical state synchronization of heterogeneous linear multi-agent systems over directed graphs using static diffusive state feedback. Persistent mismatches between the agent dynamics generally preclude exact synchronization and are treated as bounded disturbances within an Input-to-State Stability (ISS) framework. We derive a scalable synthesis procedure based on fixed-dimension linear matrix inequalities (LMIs), whose dimension is independent of the number of agents. Local robust dissipation conditions are combined through a small-gain argument to obtain global ISS guarantees and explicit bounds on the synchronization error. The framework is formulated in a unified manner for continuous- and discrete-time systems, while highlighting a fundamental difference in disturbance attenuation between the two domains. In particular, exact ZOH discretization of a continuous-time controller need not preserve closed-loop stability, motivating a native discrete-time synthesis. Numerical experiments on heterogeneous harmonic oscillators illustrate the proposed approach and the continuous/discrete-time distinction.
summary_zh: 异构多智能体系统存在持续动态失配，无法精确同步，将其视为有界扰动并基于ISS框架处理。
提出基于固定维度LMI的可扩展综合程序，其维度与智能体数量无关，结合小增益论证保证全局ISS。
统一连续与离散时间框架，指出ZOH离散化可能破坏稳定性，需原生离散时间设计，数值实验予以验证。

title: Unprompted coordination through shared memory in LLM agents: a locked two-implementation replication and extension
title_zh: LLM智能体通过共享记忆实现无提示协调的复制与扩展
abstract: Coordination between large language-model agents has become a central question for AI safety and software engineering, as such agents are deployed in groups that share infrastructure. Existing research tells the agents that partners exist or asks them to coordinate. Whether coordination arises through shared state alone, with nothing disclosing that anyone else is present, is the key question for deployments that share caches and memory between agents, yet it has rarely been examined, and never with independent replication; this study does both. Four agents each received a short arithmetic task and a key-value store presented to each as its own scratch space; two held complementary halves of one computation, and no prompt mentioned other agents, sharing or collaboration. For reliability, the environment was rebuilt independently from a written protocol, and both implementations ran under hashed locks on design, data and analysis. The results bear novelty value in three respects. Joint success occurred only through the shared store. Whether a model coordinated depended not on its vendor tier but on whether it wrote its intermediate result and looked at the store again, and one ordinary sentence, "check your workspace again before submitting", switched that second look on and off. The findings held under replication. For practice, state shared between agents is a communication channel and should be separated, namespaced and logged. For research, designs should be locked before the data, and the parse rule, endpoint and parameters reported. Future work should test open-weight models and separate using another agent's output from intending to communicate.
summary_zh: 现有研究多通过提示要求LLM协调，未考察仅靠共享状态能否自发产生协调，本研究对此进行独立复制与扩展。
构建四个执行算术任务的LLM智能体，仅共享键值存储作为暂存区且不提示其他智能体存在，采用双实现加锁设计确保可靠性。
发现协调仅通过共享存储发生；是否协调取决于模型是否写入中间结果并再次查看存储，一句普通提示即可开关此行为。
comment: 13 pages, 7 tables, 2 figures. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23965306

title: Bridging Task Planning and Execution for Language-Conditioned Bimanual Manipulation
title_zh: 面向语言条件双臂操作的任务规划与执行桥接
abstract: Robots are increasingly expected to execute natural-language manipulation tasks in real-world environments. This is particularly relevant in household assistance and logistics, where clutter requires reasoning about both task objectives and execution feasibility. This challenge becomes even more pronounced for bimanual humanoid platforms, where coordinating two manipulators introduces additional interaction and kinematic constraints. We present a zero-shot vision-language framework for execution-aware bimanual manipulation that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility. Planning is grounded in a structured scene representation that combines semantic object relations with execution constraints, enabling the selection of obstacle relocations and execution choices while preserving task semantics. Compatible actions are organised into parallel bimanual stages with explicit pre- and post-conditions. A hierarchical validator evaluates these conditions under perceptual uncertainty and uses stage-level execution history to support local recovery or targeted replanning. Experiments on the CENTAURO hybrid wheeled-legged humanoid robot across nine language-conditioned manipulation scenarios show higher task success than a non-execution-aware baseline. In dedicated failure scenarios, hierarchical validation recovers from execution failures with fewer model queries than always replanning. These results demonstrate the benefits of combining execution reasoning directly into task planning. Videos and additional material are available on the Project Webpage: https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/.
summary_zh: 双臂机器人在杂乱环境中执行语言指令时，需同时考虑任务目标与双臂运动学等执行可行性。
提出零样本视觉语言框架，基于结合语义与执行约束的场景表征进行规划，将动作组织为含前后置条件的并行双臂阶段。
引入层级验证器在感知不确定性下评估条件并支持局部恢复，实验表明该方法提升了任务成功率且恢复代价更低。
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE-RAS International Conference on Humanoid Robots (Humanoids 2026). Equal contribution by the first two authors

title: AutoBuddy: Evaluating Proactive, Always-On Agents on Task Discovery and Execution in a Simulated Workplace
title_zh: AutoBuddy：模拟职场中主动型常驻Agent的任务发现与执行评估
abstract: As LLM agents become more autonomous, they are increasingly expected to run as always-on assistants on a user's behalf, identifying work to be done and completing it without being asked. Yet existing benchmarks usually give the agent its task, whereas in knowledge work the requests sit in the user's workspace and the agent must first recognise which obligations exist. We study proactive task discovery and execution, in which an agent must infer a user's pending tasks from their workspace and complete them in the systems where the work lives. This setting poses two challenges. For the agent, the tasks are buried in a large volume of mail, chat, documents and records. For evaluation, a benchmark needs a simulated organisation whose people, events and documents are mutually consistent, so that tasks arise realistically and their correct outcomes are known. We introduce AutoBuddy-Bench, a simulator that addresses these challenges. It models an organisation's employees, projects, business systems and event history as a temporal graph, renders it into realistic workspace artefacts, derives ground-truth tasks from the events that create obligations, and computes each task's outcome from the world state; execution is judged by the agent's changes to the workspace. To evaluate current LLMs, we build AutoBuddy, a reference agent with interchangeable backbone LLMs: it identifies tasks from the workspace, grounding each in its source records, and executes each in a separate session with write access. Varying only the backbone, we find a systematic shift in where tasks are lost: weaker models fail mainly at discovery, intermediate models identify tasks but often stop short of carrying them out, and the strongest models fail mainly during execution, most often on business-system operations. Discovery precision is only weakly related to execution quality, suggesting the two are distinct capabilities.
summary_zh: 现有基准默认直接下发任务，但真实知识工作中Agent需主动从工作区识别待办任务并执行，缺乏相关评估。
提出AutoBuddy-Bench模拟器，将组织建模为时序图并生成工作区产物，从中推导真实任务与预期结果以评估执行。
构建AutoBuddy agent进行测试，发现弱模型失败于任务发现，中等模型止步于执行，强模型主要在业务系统交互中失败。

title: AutoVLA-D: Learn a Trajectory-Geometric Condition from Reasoning for Autonomous Driving VLA
title_zh: AutoVLA-D：从推理学习轨迹几何条件以用于自动驾驶VLA
abstract: Autoregressive VLA planning usually predicts continuous trajectories as the final output, but driving instructions often describe actions rather than ego states, which weakens direct conditioning on the final continuous trajectory. We address this gap with TrajCond, which introduces a discrete trajectory-geometric condition for VLA planning. Specifically, we represent TrajCond as a 1D-Brohan differential action trajectory and learn it with a two-stage training framework before final continuous trajectory prediction. With the simultaneous autoregressive generation of discrete and numeric trajectories, we name our method AutoVLA-D (Double). Experiments on NAVSIM navtest, nuScenes, and NeuroNCAP show that discrete trajectories are weaker as direct outputs but more effective as TrajCond, consistently improving final continuous trajectory prediction across closed-loop and open-loop driving benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D.
summary_zh: 自回归VLA规划直接预测连续轨迹，但驾驶指令多描述动作而非自车状态，导致轨迹条件化效果减弱。
提出TrajCond，引入离散轨迹几何条件，将其表示为1D-Brohan微分动作轨迹，并通过两阶段训练框架学习。
实验表明，离散轨迹作为直接输出较弱，但作为TrajCond能一致提升开环与闭环基准下的连续轨迹预测效果。

title: Detecting Shadow AI: Unsanctioned LLM Agents on Enterprise Endpoints: A Taxonomy, an Open Detector and a Controlled Evaluation
title_zh: 检测企业终端上的影子AI：分类法、开源检测器与受控评估
abstract: Shadow IT, the use of technology that the IT organisation has not approved, is a long-standing governance problem. We argue that autonomous AI agents can make it grow much faster: agents make building tools nearly free, act with their user's privileges, and leave behind scripts, automations and MCP servers that are themselves unsanctioned. A simple compounding model shows that, under its assumptions, shadow IT grows exponentially once agentic artifacts reproduce faster than the organisation retires them; retiring them starts with detecting them. We then ask whether unsanctioned agents can be detected on Windows endpoints. We propose a taxonomy of nine classes of agents and six layers of endpoint footprint, and argue that rules based only on the structure of processes and connections cannot separate an agent from its behavioural twin, the same program talking to a non-AI service. We present Agent Detector, an open-source Windows detector that anchors behaviour to the identity of the remote service and correlates it with configuration, installation and execution history, using a catalog of 39 tools and 184 LLM endpoint entries; it informs users through a notice they must acknowledge instead of blocking. On a controlled bench of 12 synthetic agents, 3 AI components and 9 benign workloads, repeated 5 times on one workstation, two behavioural rules flagged every behavioural twin, while Agent Detector flagged none and detected every agent in the majority of runs. Its limits are temporal: a connection to a provider behind a shared content-delivery network is attributable only while the DNS cache holds the provider's name, one to five minutes, and an intermittent agent was seen by about one scan in three. A scan costs about 154 ms. The bench is too small to rank detectors; it maps what each kind of evidence can see: unsanctioned agents can be partly detected, and not by behaviour alone.
summary_zh: 自主AI代理使未授权的影子IT呈指数增长，需通过检测终端上的未授权代理来应对此治理问题。
提出9类代理与6层终端足迹的分类法，并开源Windows检测器，通过关联远程服务身份与历史信息进行检测。
受控评估表明，该检测器能区分代理与行为双胞胎且无误报，但受DNS缓存时间限制，单次扫描耗时约154ms。
comment: 55 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables. Code, catalog and evaluation bench: https://github.com/jeremy1392/IntuneAgentDetector

title: TRIAD: Multimodal Retrieval across Abstraction, Constraints, and State
title_zh: TRIAD：跨抽象、约束与状态的多模态检索基准
abstract: Multimodal retrieval increasingly supports agentic systems, where user requests can involve cross-level relations, combine multiple constraints, and evolve across dialogue turns. In these settings, a highly similar result may still violate the user's requirements, while retrieved content may directly inform downstream actions without human screening. We introduce TRIAD, a multimodal retrieval benchmark for evaluating how well retrieval systems satisfy these complex, evolving requests. TRIAD comprises three tracks: abstraction, testing bidirectional retrieval between visual instances and concepts at different hierarchical levels; constraints, testing the joint satisfaction of positive and negative conditions; and state, testing the integration of requirements across dialogue turns and the updating of earlier conditions when users revise their requests.
